name: 终南集·AGI编剧大师·内置创作技能包

engines.name: 喜剧机制

devices.name: 预期违背
devices.principle: 先沿观众惯性把预期铺到最高，再用一个更合理却完全相反的结果落地，落差即笑点
devices.principleEn: Build the audience expectation along habit, then land on a more logical yet opposite result; the gap is the joke
devices.technique: 前两拍认真铺垫惯性（越正经越好），第三拍一次反转兑现；铺垫里埋一个被忽略的伏笔，让反转“意料之外、情理之中”
devices.techniqueEn: Play the first two beats dead straight, cash the third beat as a turn; plant one overlooked detail so the twist is surprising yet earned
devices.risk: 为反而反、结果不合人物逻辑会变成闹剧；反转必须能从前文推出
devices.riskEn: A turn that ignores character logic becomes farce; the reversal must be derivable from setup

devices.name: 三翻四抖/递进重复
devices.principle: 同一情境重复两次建立规律，第三次在重复中升级或变形产生笑果（四抖）
devices.principleEn: Repeat a pattern twice to set a rule; the third iteration escalates or mutates it for the laugh
devices.technique: 设计一个可复用的动作/台词母题，三次出现逐级加码（规模、代价、围观者反应都升级），第四次抖出最大反差后立刻收，不拖
devices.techniqueEn: Create a reusable action/line motif, escalate it on each repeat (scale, stakes, onlookers), then drop the biggest contrast and cut fast
devices.risk: 重复超过四次不升级就腻；每次重复必须有新信息
devices.riskEn: Repeating without escalation past three turns goes stale; each repeat needs new information

devices.name: CallBack 回扣
devices.principle: 把前段一个看似无用的闲笔/台词在后面关键处重新调用，观众因“我记得”而获得智力与会心双重满足
devices.principleEn: Revive an earlier throwaway line/detail at a key moment; recognition gives the audience an intellectual, in-on-the-joke pleasure
devices.technique: 开场前三集埋一个不起眼的口头禅/道具/承诺，在高潮或尴尬顶点原样回扣，措辞尽量一致以触发记忆
devices.techniqueEn: Plant an unremarkable catchphrase/prop/promise early, repeat it verbatim at the peak or most awkward moment to trigger recognition
devices.risk: 回扣点离铺垫太远观众会忘；闲笔不能刻意到一眼是伏笔
devices.riskEn: Too far apart and the audience forgets; the plant must not look like an obvious setup

devices.name: 一本正经地胡说
devices.principle: 越荒诞的内容用越冷静、流程化、专业的态度说出来，态度与内容的反差产生冷幽默
devices.principleEn: Deliver the absurd with calm, procedural, professional seriousness; tone-versus-content contrast makes dry humor
devices.technique: 让角色用开会/填表/做实验的严谨逻辑处理离谱事件，配术语和步骤，自己绝不笑场；周围人越认真越好笑
devices.techniqueEn: Have characters treat the ridiculous with meeting-notes / lab-procedure rigor and jargon, never breaking face; the straighter everyone else, the funnier
devices.risk: 演员/文本一笑场就垮；荒诞也要有自洽规则
devices.riskEn: Winking at the audience kills it; the absurd still needs self-consistent rules

devices.name: 信息差误会升级
devices.principle: 双方掌握的信息不对称，每个角色都按自己掌握的“真相”行动，越努力解释误会越深
devices.principleEn: Asymmetric information: each side acts on its own version of the truth; the harder they explain, the deeper the misunderstanding
devices.technique: 先让观众全知（比角色多知道一层），再让角色每次补救都恰好踩中下一个误会；每次升级提高代价，直到一个共同信息出现才一次性引爆
devices.techniqueEn: Make the audience omniscient, then have each fix trigger the next misunderstanding; raise the stakes each round until one shared fact detonates it all
devices.risk: 靠“主角就是不听解释”硬拖会招黑；误会升级要靠信息结构而非角色降智
devices.riskEn: Forced “they just won’t listen” drag annoys viewers; escalation must come from information structure, not dumbed-down characters

devices.name: 反差人设对撞
devices.principle: 把两套截然相反的行为逻辑关进同一情境（如社恐×话痨、劫匪×洁癖），冲突自带笑料
devices.principleEn: Trap two opposite behavioral logics in one situation (introvert×chatterbox, robber×germaphobe); the clash generates comedy by itself
devices.technique: 给每个角色一个“绝不能违背”的行为铁律，让两条铁律在同一目标下正面相撞；笑点写在双方都没做错却无法调和处
devices.techniqueEn: Give each character an unbreakable behavioral rule and force the rules to collide toward one goal; the joke is that neither is wrong yet they cannot reconcile
devices.risk: 人设只有标签没有逻辑会变小品喊口号；反差要靠选择而非造型
devices.riskEn: A label without logic is just a sketch catchphrase; contrast must show in choices, not costumes

devices.name: 大型社死现场
devices.principle: 当众暴露本想隐藏的真相，唤起观众“替他尴尬”的安全共情，尴尬到极致反而是爽
devices.principleEn: Public exposure of a hidden truth triggers safe vicarious embarrassment; cringe pushed to the extreme flips into relief
devices.technique: 先让角色拼命维持一个体面假象并让观众知道破绽，再安排最不该出现的人/设备（投屏、麦没关）当众揭穿，给一个想补救却越抹越黑的动作
devices.techniqueEn: Let the character fight to keep up appearances while the audience sees the crack, then expose it publicly via the worst witness/device (screen mirror, hot mic), followed by a dig-deeper recovery
devices.risk: 纯羞辱弱者不好笑反招厌；社死对象最好有自作自受或可爱属性
devices.riskEn: Punching down is not funny; the target should be sympathetic or have brought it on themselves

devices.name: 节奏顿挫与留白
devices.principle: 笑点=铺垫+停顿+抖包袱，停顿让观众自己补完预期，再在补完的瞬间打破
devices.principleEn: A joke is setup + pause + punchline; the pause lets the audience finish the expectation so you can break it the instant they do
devices.technique: 包袱前给一个明确的动作停顿或镜头留白（0.5-1秒），抖包袱用短句、把最意外的词放句尾；一场戏只留一个主包袱，其余做小笑点垫
devices.techniqueEn: Insert a clear beat/pause before the punchline (0.5–1s), use a short sentence with the most unexpected word last; one main joke per scene, smaller gags only as padding
devices.risk: 句句是梗等于没有梗，台词过满挤掉观众反应时间
devices.riskEn: A joke in every line means no joke at all; overstuffed lines leave no room to react

devices.name: 细节夸张与具象化
devices.principle: 抽象吐槽不好笑，把情绪夸张成一个具体、可视、超规格的画面/动作才好笑
devices.principleEn: Abstract complaint is not funny; exaggerate an emotion into one concrete, visual, over-scaled image or action
devices.technique: 把“很生气/很穷/很慌”改写成一个具体到离谱的动作或物件（如穷到给花呗设特别关注），用数字和细节让画面可拍
devices.techniqueEn: Turn “furious/broke/panicked” into one absurdly specific, filmable action or object, using numbers and detail
devices.risk: 夸张脱离人物处境会悬浮；夸张点要服务人物而非炫技
devices.riskEn: Exaggeration detached from the situation floats free; it must serve the character

devices.name: 毒舌下的温柔/反套路
devices.principle: 用嘴硬刻薄的方式表达在乎，或故意绕开类型片老套桥段，观众在“以为要狗血”时被真诚/新鲜击中
devices.principleEn: Express care through gruff sarcasm, or deliberately dodge the genre cliché; hit the audience with sincerity or novelty right when they expect melodrama
devices.technique: 该煽情处让角色说反话、该套路处让角色“吐槽剧本”并选一个更真实的做法；吐槽点到为止，最后仍落到真情
devices.techniqueEn: At the emotional beat let the character say the opposite; at the cliché beat have them call it out and choose the truer action. Keep meta-jokes brief and land on real feeling
devices.risk: 为反套路而消解所有情感会空心；吐槽不能打断关键情绪
devices.riskEn: Subverting every emotion leaves it hollow; meta-commentary must not break a key emotional beat

engines.name: 悬疑烧脑机制

devices.name: 密室/不可能犯罪
devices.principle: 在看似物理不可能的条件下发生案件，谜底是一个被观众忽略的空间/时间/机械漏洞
devices.principleEn: A crime occurs under seemingly impossible physical conditions; the answer is one overlooked spatial, temporal or mechanical loophole
devices.technique: 先完整交代密室条件（门窗、目击者、时间），再用一条不起眼的细节（门锁结构、通风、声音延迟）给出唯一解；所有诡计部件在前半段都出现过
devices.techniqueEn: Establish the locked conditions fully (doors, witnesses, timing), then solve via one easy-to-miss detail (lock mechanism, vent, sound delay); every trick component appeared earlier
devices.risk: 谜底用了从未展示的道具或巧合等于作弊；密室解法不能依赖超自然
devices.riskEn: Solving with an unshown device or coincidence is cheating; no supernatural escape

devices.name: 不在场证明拆解
devices.principle: 嫌疑人有铁证般的不在场证明，突破口是时间感、距离或“证明人认知”里的一个误差
devices.principleEn: The suspect has an ironclad alibi; the crack is an error in perceived time, distance or the witness’s cognition
devices.technique: 把不在场证明拆成可验证的时间轴（几点几分在哪、谁看见、耗时多少），在其中埋一个“看似连续实则有缺口”的环节，用交通工具/录音/习惯动作制造时间差
devices.techniqueEn: Break the alibi into a verifiable timeline (where/who/how long each minute), embed one gap that looks continuous, manufacture the time gap via transport, recording or habit
devices.risk: 时间误差必须经得起观众按计算器，不能靠模糊带过
devices.riskEn: The time gap must survive the audience checking the clock; never hand-wave it

devices.name: 叙述性诡计
devices.principle: 利用叙述视角天然省略/歧义误导观众（隐去身份、时间、人称），揭晓时回看处处成立
devices.principleEn: Mislead through omissions or ambiguity inherent in the POV (hidden identity, time or person); on reveal every earlier line still holds
devices.technique: 选定一个被默认却没明说的假设（叙述者性别/与死者关系/现在与回忆），全程只给“为真但有歧义”的表述，揭晓时用原句回放证明没说谎
devices.techniqueEn: Pick an assumed-but-never-stated fact (narrator’s gender, tie to victim, present vs memory), write only true-but-ambiguous lines, then replay original lines on reveal to prove no lie was told
devices.risk: 不能靠隐瞒关键信息硬骗；回看必须严丝合缝，否则观众觉得被耍
devices.riskEn: Do not cheat by hiding crucial facts; a re-read must fit perfectly or the audience feels tricked

devices.name: 身份替换/伪装
devices.principle: 某人以另一重身份存在，反差来自身份错位带来的信息与权力差
devices.principleEn: Someone operates under another identity; the tension comes from the information and power gap of the mismatch
devices.technique: 提前埋三个只有“知道真身才懂”的细节（习惯、旧伤、知情度），让替身/真身各有合理动机，揭晓靠细节闭环而非口头解释
devices.techniqueEn: Plant three details only understandable with the true identity (habit, old scar, privileged knowledge); give both identities sound motives; close the loop through details, not exposition
devices.risk: 易和“真假千金”套路撞车；伪装必须有成本与破绽，不能全程无敌
devices.riskEn: Easily collides with the swapped-heiress cliché; disguise needs cost and cracks, not invincibility

devices.name: 多重反转/套娃
devices.principle: 每一层“真相”都推翻上一层，但反转次数越多越需要清晰主线，否则观众疲劳
devices.principleEn: Each layer of truth overturns the last; the more turns, the clearer the spine must be or the audience burns out
devices.technique: 反转不超过三次且层层升级（以为是A→其实是B→真正主使是C），每次反转都改变“谁受益”；提前为每层埋一个专属伏笔，最后一次反转回扣开场
devices.techniqueEn: Cap turns at three and escalate each (seems A → actually B → C is the real hand); each turn changes who benefits; plant a distinct clue per layer and let the final turn callback the opening
devices.risk: 为反转而反转、动机撑不住会崩；反转后人物行为仍要自洽
devices.riskEn: Twists without supporting motives collapse; behavior must stay consistent after each turn

devices.name: 伏线公平回收
devices.principle: 悬疑的爽感来自“原来早就告诉我了”，所有关键线索必须在揭晓前公平出现
devices.principleEn: The thrill is “it was shown all along”; every key clue must appear fairly before the reveal
devices.technique: 列一张线索清单：破案所需的每条信息标注首次出现的集/场，确保都在谜底前；用生活场景把关键线索“藏”在无关信息里（一次带过、不强调）
devices.techniqueEn: Keep a clue ledger: mark the first scene of every fact needed to solve it, all before the reveal; hide key clues in plain sight inside mundane beats, mentioned once without emphasis
devices.risk: 关键证据临时空降=作弊；线索也不能反复特写提示到没悬念
devices.riskEn: Last-minute evidence is cheating; over-flagging clues kills suspense

devices.name: 社会派动机
devices.principle: 重点不在“怎么作案”而在“为什么走到这一步”，用社会结构/人性困境制造后劲
devices.principleEn: The focus is not how but why it came to this; social structure and human dilemma create the aftertaste
devices.technique: 案件只是入口，沿动机倒推人物处境（阶层、家庭、制度性伤害），让凶手逻辑可被理解但不被认同；用一个具体生活场景承载社会议题，不喊口号
devices.techniqueEn: Treat the case as an entrance, reverse-engineer the character’s situation (class, family, systemic harm); make the logic understandable yet not endorsed; carry the issue in one concrete life scene, no slogans
devices.risk: 议题先行、推理让位会变成说教；动机再值得同情也不能替代证据链
devices.riskEn: Message-first, mystery-second becomes preaching; a sympathetic motive never replaces the evidence chain

devices.name: 罗生门多视角
devices.principle: 同一事件由不同利益方各说各话，真相在矛盾证词的交集处
devices.principleEn: Different stakeholders recount the same event differently; truth lies in the intersection of conflicting testimony
devices.technique: 给每个视角一个“对自己有利的偏差”，让证词两两矛盾但各自自洽；用一个无法作伪的客观物证（监控时间、伤情）当锚点，逐步对齐出真相
devices.techniqueEn: Give each POV a self-serving bias so testimonies conflict yet each feels coherent; use one unfakeable anchor (camera timestamp, injury) to align the truth step by step
devices.risk: 视角太多观众记不住；每个撒谎者都要有可理解的理由，不能全员为反而反
devices.riskEn: Too many POVs confuse; each liar needs an understandable reason, not contradiction for its own sake

devices.name: 倒计时/时限压迫
devices.principle: 给侦查设一个硬性截止时间，时间压力把推理和动作拧成一股绳
devices.principleEn: Impose a hard deadline on the investigation; time pressure fuses deduction and action into one line
devices.technique: 开场明确时限与代价（几点前找不到会发生什么），每个侦查动作都消耗可见时间，在临近截止处安排一次错误方向，最后用省下来的一个时间缝隙翻盘
devices.techniqueEn: State the deadline and its cost up front, make every investigative move cost visible time, send the lead down a wrong path near the deadline, then turn it on a saved sliver of time
devices.risk: 时限若不影响角色决策就是假倒计时；要让观众随时知道还剩多少时间
devices.riskEn: A clock that never changes decisions is fake; the audience must always know the time left

devices.name: 安乐椅/信息拼图
devices.principle: 侦探不必亲临险境，靠把散落的公开信息重新排列组合推出结论，凸显智力快感
devices.principleEn: The detective need not face danger; rearranging scattered public information yields the answer, foregrounding intellectual pleasure
devices.technique: 把破案信息拆成多份分别给到不同角色/渠道（新闻、闲聊、账单），让观众和侦探同步拿到碎片，在揭晓前给一次“拼图蒙太奇”让观众能抢先一步
devices.techniqueEn: Split case information across characters and channels (news, chatter, receipts); give the audience the same fragments, and run a puzzle montage before the reveal so viewers can beat the detective to it
devices.risk: 信息不能藏在观众看不到处；拼图结论必须是碎片的唯一合理解
devices.riskEn: Information cannot hide off-screen; the assembled conclusion must be the fragments’ only sound reading

engines.name: 文旅机制

devices.name: 地标入戏
devices.principle: 地标不是背景板，让关键冲突只能在这个地点、借这个空间结构发生
devices.principleEn: A landmark is not wallpaper; the key conflict can only happen in this place using its spatial layout
devices.technique: 选 1-2 个真实地标，把追逐/对峙/告白安排在其独有结构上（桥头、戏台、缆车、古城门洞），用空间高差、出入口、人流制造阻碍与转折
devices.techniqueEn: Pick 1–2 real landmarks and stage the chase/confrontation/confession on their unique structure (bridgehead, opera stage, cable car, old-town gate); use elevation, exits and crowds as obstacles and turns
devices.risk: 一集塞太多地标等于旅游流水账；每个出现的地标都要承担情节功能
devices.riskEn: Cramming landmarks per episode becomes a travelogue; every landmark shown must carry a plot function

devices.name: 非遗做情节机关
devices.principle: 把一门非遗技艺的工序变成解谜、翻盘或定情的关键，技艺过程即剧情过程
devices.principleEn: Turn the steps of an intangible-heritage craft into the key to a puzzle, comeback or romance; the craft process becomes the plot process
devices.technique: 选一门本地非遗（剪纸、皮影、扎染、制陶、社火），让其一道核心工序在高潮成为破局点，提前两集自然展示工序做伏笔，避免临时百科解说
devices.techniqueEn: Choose a local heritage craft (paper-cut, shadow puppetry, tie-dye, pottery, folk fire dance); make one core step the turning point at climax, and show that step naturally two episodes earlier as setup instead of last-minute exposition
devices.risk: 不能大段念非遗介绍打断剧情；技艺细节必须经得起专业推敲，不张冠李戴
devices.riskEn: Never pause the story for a documentary lecture; craft details must be accurate, not mixed up between regions

devices.name: 美食做情绪锚点
devices.principle: 一道地方食物绑定一段关系或记忆，重复出现、每次情绪不同，成为人物的情感刻度
devices.principleEn: Bind one local dish to a relationship or memory; repeat it with shifting emotion so it becomes the character’s emotional marker
devices.technique: 选一道有制作过程的本地小吃，首现建立关系（一起做/第一次尝），复现用于冲突或和解，最后一次出现承载和解或离别；写清声音、热气、手感等可拍细节
devices.techniqueEn: Choose one local snack with a making process: first appearance builds the bond (cooking together / first taste), a repeat fuels conflict or reconciliation, the final serving carries closure or parting; write filmable sound, steam and texture
devices.risk: 只报菜名没有人物情绪就是美食广告；避免刻板化“某地人只吃某样”
devices.riskEn: Listing dish names without emotion is a food ad; avoid stereotyping a whole region by one food

devices.name: 方言烟火气
devices.principle: 用方言词汇、称谓、语气节奏建立地域真实感，让人物一开口就“是这儿的人”
devices.principleEn: Dialect words, forms of address and speech rhythm establish regional authenticity; one line and the character belongs to the place
devices.technique: 挑 5-8 个全国观众能听懂的本地高频词/口头禅点缀（不整句方言以免出字幕障碍），配合本地称谓与生活习惯；主角对外来人可自然“翻译”，兼顾普适
devices.techniqueEn: Sprinkle 5–8 widely understandable local words/catchphrases rather than whole dialect sentences (subtitle barrier); pair with local forms of address and habits; a local can naturally “translate” for an outsider to stay universal
devices.risk: 方言堆砌或用错会被本地观众挑错、外地观众出戏；忌地域刻板印象与地图炮
devices.riskEn: Overdone or wrong dialect is caught by locals and alienates others; avoid regional stereotypes and cheap shots

devices.name: 地方传说/名人新编
devices.principle: 借用本地传说、历史名人或地名由来做故事母题，与现代主线互文，增加文化厚度
devices.principleEn: Borrow a local legend, historical figure or place-name origin as the story motif, intertextual with the modern line for cultural depth
devices.technique: 找一个与主题同构的本地传说（如坚守、归来、相守），让主角处境与传说形成镜像，关键抉择处用传说点题但不照搬结局；史实人物只取公认事实，不杜撰争议
devices.techniqueEn: Find a local legend structurally matching the theme (persistence, return, devotion), mirror the protagonist’s predicament in it, echo it at the key choice without copying its ending; for real historical figures use only accepted facts, never fabricate controversy
devices.risk: 戏说历史名人、篡改民族/宗教叙事有合规与情感风险；传说只能点到为止
devices.riskEn: Frivolously rewriting historical figures or ethnic/religious narratives carries compliance risk; keep echoes light

devices.name: 景区动线即剧情地图
devices.principle: 把一条真实游览动线（码头→老街→山顶）设计成剧情推进路线，空间顺序=起承转合
devices.principleEn: Design a real visiting route (dock → old street → summit) as the progression line; spatial order equals setup-development-turn-resolution
devices.technique: 按真实可达的游览顺序安排场次，每到一个点位关系/信息推进一步，用“离终点还有多远”制造进度感与倒计时，点位之间安排移动戏而非转场硬切
devices.techniqueEn: Order scenes along a real, walkable route; each stop advances relationship or information; use distance-to-end for progress and a ticking clock; write scenes during movement between stops instead of hard cuts
devices.risk: 动线不符合真实地理会被游客识破；不能为剧情让角色瞬移
devices.riskEn: Tourists spot impossible geography; never teleport characters for plot convenience

devices.name: 民宿/客栈社交场
devices.principle: 民宿、茶馆、夜市这类“来来往往的容器”天然汇聚冲突与人物，是文旅剧低成本主场景
devices.principleEn: An inn, teahouse or night market is a container of comings and goings, naturally gathering characters and conflict — a low-cost main set
devices.technique: 把一家本地民宿/小店设为主场，让返乡主角在此遇到不同客人、每个客人带一个事件，店主身份串起本地关系网；用经营压力（淡季、拆迁、竞争）做主线驱动
devices.techniqueEn: Make a local B&B/shop the home base where the returning lead meets guests, each bringing an incident; the owner role ties the local network; use business pressure (off-season, demolition, competition) as the engine
devices.risk: 单元客人不能工具化，每个过客也要有自己的诉求；主场要写出地域质感而非通用客栈
devices.riskEn: Episodic guests must not be tools — each needs their own want; the set must feel regional, not a generic inn

devices.name: 城市气质定影像基调
devices.principle: 城市有性格（雾都迷离、海岛明亮、西北苍凉），影像基调与节奏应被地域气质统一
devices.principleEn: A city has temperament (foggy-mysterious, island-bright, northwest-bleak); visual tone and rhythm should be unified by it
devices.technique: 先用三个词定城市气质，再据此定光影（晨雾/斜阳）、色调、配乐乐器与剪辑节奏；让天气与季节参与情绪（雨天摊牌、雪夜和解），空镜只在情绪转折点使用
devices.techniqueEn: Define the city in three words, then set light (morning fog / slanted sun), palette, local instruments and editing rhythm; let weather and season carry emotion (rainy confrontation, snowy reconciliation); use establishing shots only at emotional turns
devices.risk: 空镜堆砌、风光片化会拖节奏；每个空镜都要有情绪功能
devices.riskEn: B-roll overload and tourism-film pacing drag; every establishing shot needs an emotional function

devices.name: 风物特产做道具伏笔
devices.principle: 把特产、药材、器物当关键道具与伏笔，让“只有这儿才有”的东西推动翻盘
devices.principleEn: Use local produce, herbs or artifacts as key props and foreshadowing; something “only found here” drives the turnaround
devices.technique: 选一样辨识度高的本地风物，早期作为闲笔出现（送人、置办），在关键处成为证据/解药/信物完成回收；交代其独特性时用人物动作而非旁白
devices.techniqueEn: Choose one recognizable local item, plant it early as a throwaway (a gift, an errand), then cash it as evidence / remedy / token at the key moment; convey its uniqueness through action, not narration
devices.risk: 不能把特产功效神化、做虚假宣传；回收要符合常识
devices.riskEn: Do not mythologize a product’s efficacy or run false advertising; payoff must respect common sense

devices.name: 剧情优先/软植入底线
devices.principle: 文旅的吸引力来自“我想去那生活”，靠人物与故事让观众向往，而非直接喊口号
devices.principleEn: Tourism appeal is “I want to live there” — desire is created through people and story, not slogans
devices.technique: 先立人物困境与情感，文旅元素只在“解决困境/承载情感”时出现；每集硬宣传信息不超过一处且化进台词或动作；结尾用人物的留下/归来完成情感种草，不出现“欢迎来到XX”式口号
devices.techniqueEn: Build character trouble and emotion first; tourism elements appear only to solve trouble or carry feeling; at most one soft info beat per episode, woven into line or action; close on the character staying/returning rather than a “welcome to…” slogan
devices.risk: 一旦观众察觉在被推销就会划走；地域呈现要真实，不美化现实问题
devices.riskEn: Once viewers smell a sales pitch they scroll away; portray the place truthfully, not airbrushed

engines.name: 穿书穿越机制

devices.name: 穿成炮灰/配角
devices.principle: 主角带着上帝视角穿成注定领盒饭的小角色，最大张力是“知道自己会死”与“如何改命”
devices.principleEn: The lead, with reader foreknowledge, wakes as a minor character fated to die; tension is knowing the death and fighting to rewrite it
devices.technique: 开场就交代原著里这个角色的死法与倒计时，主角每改一步都引发原著的连锁反作用力；把“求生”拆成几个可执行的小目标，逐个打脸原剧情
devices.techniqueEn: Open by stating the character’s canonical death and its countdown; every change triggers a chain reaction from the original plot; break survival into executable goals that beat the canon one by one
devices.risk: 主角若全知全能就没张力；必须保留信息盲区与改命代价
devices.riskEn: An omniscient lead has no tension; keep blind spots and a cost to changing fate

devices.name: 穿成反派/恶毒女配
devices.principle: 穿成人人喊打的反派，主角靠“知道所有人结局”反向洗白/布局，反差与求生欲是核心爽点
devices.principleEn: Waking as the hated villain, the lead uses knowledge of every ending to whitewash/outmaneuver; contrast and survival drive the payoff
devices.technique: 第一场先让主角承受原反派留下的烂摊子（仇家、婚约、黑料），用“反向操作”把原反派的恶行逐个变成翻盘筹码；关键关系人态度转变要有过程、不能一集倒戈
devices.techniqueEn: Open with the mess the original villain left (enemies, engagement, bad PR), turn each villainous deed into leverage by reversing it; relationship turns must be earned, not flipped in one episode
devices.risk: 洗白不能靠他人集体失忆；原反派做过的恶要被正视和偿还
devices.riskEn: Redemption cannot rely on collective amnesia; the original villain’s wrongs must be faced and paid

devices.name: 白月光/替身错位
devices.principle: 穿成男主的白月光或其替身，利用“知道感情线走向”在错位关系里夺回主动权
devices.principleEn: Reincarnated as the male lead’s first love or her substitute, the lead uses knowledge of the romance arc to seize agency in a mismatched relationship
devices.technique: 先立清原著感情线（谁爱谁、谁是替身、第几集变心），主角刻意避开原剧情的情感陷阱，把“被选择”改成“我选择”；用一次主动退出测试对方真心，制造情感反转
devices.techniqueEn: Lay out the canonical love line (who loves whom, who is the substitute, when feelings shift); the lead deliberately dodges its traps, turning “being chosen” into “I choose”; test true feelings with one deliberate exit
devices.risk: 感情不能靠主角背剧本强推；对方心动要有具体事件支撑
devices.riskEn: Romance cannot be forced by reciting the script; attraction needs concrete events

devices.name: 原著剧情惯性/修正力
devices.principle: 世界会自我修正把偏离的剧情拉回原著，主角与“剧情惯性”对抗是穿书独有的外部压力源
devices.principleEn: The world self-corrects to pull a derailed story back to canon; fighting plot inertia is the genre’s unique external pressure
devices.technique: 设定明确的修正规则（小偏离遇巧合拉回、大改付出代价、关键节点最难改），让主角每次改命都遭遇升级的阻力；在某个关键节点让主角以为成功后剧情以另一种方式兑现原结局，制造二次危机
devices.techniqueEn: Set clear correction rules (small deviations pulled back by coincidence, big changes cost more, key nodes hardest); after a seeming win at a key node, let the canon ending arrive another way for a second crisis
devices.risk: 修正力不能随心所欲当万能胶水；规则一旦定下必须前后一致
devices.riskEn: Correction must not be arbitrary plot glue; once set, rules stay consistent

devices.name: 原著flag回收
devices.principle: 原著里的台词、伏笔、名场面是穿书者的“预言”，回收时给读过书的观众强烈的预判爽与反差
devices.principleEn: Canon lines, foreshadowing and famous scenes become the transmigrator’s prophecies; cashing them gives book-reading viewers strong anticipation and contrast
devices.technique: 前期让主角点出 2-3 个原著 flag（“按书里他今天会……”），部分精准兑现建立可信度，再让一个关键 flag 因主角干预而改写，形成“以为会这样结果那样”的爽点；flag 用人物原话触发记忆
devices.techniqueEn: Early on have the lead cite 2–3 canon flags; let some land exactly to build credibility, then rewrite one key flag through intervention; trigger recognition with the original wording
devices.risk: 没读过原著的观众也要能看懂，flag 出现时要自带最小上下文，不能只服务书粉
devices.riskEn: Viewers who never read the book must still follow; give each flag minimal context, not fan-service only

devices.name: 读者上帝视角×信息差
devices.principle: 主角知道全局、书中人只看眼前，信息差既制造爽点（预判）也制造危机（知道却拦不住）
devices.principleEn: The lead knows the whole book while characters see only now; the gap creates both payoff (foresight) and crisis (knowing but unable to stop)
devices.technique: 把上帝视角切成“确定知道的”和“原著没写的盲区”两类，爽点来自用已知布局，危机来自盲区爆雷；安排一个主角误读原著的点，提醒观众全知有边界
devices.techniqueEn: Split foreknowledge into “known for sure” and “gaps the book never wrote”; payoff comes from known setup, crisis from blind spots; include one moment the lead misread the book to show omniscience has limits
devices.risk: 主角不能把剧本念成流水账；已知信息要转化为行动而非旁白解说
devices.riskEn: The lead must not narrate the book aloud; turn foreknowledge into action, not exposition

devices.name: NPC觉醒/真人意识
devices.principle: 当书中人物开始偏离原著、产生自我意识，“谁是真人、谁在被书写”成为高级悬念与情感点
devices.principleEn: When a character deviates from canon and gains self-awareness, “who is real and who is written” becomes high-level suspense and emotion
devices.technique: 让一个重要配角率先察觉“自己每次都按固定轨迹行事”，用一个反常小动作暴露觉醒；主角与觉醒者从互相试探到结盟，共同对抗剧情惯性；觉醒代价（被世界抹除）制造情感重量
devices.techniqueEn: Let a key supporting character first notice they repeat a fixed track, revealed by one abnormal micro-action; lead and awakened character move from probing to alliance against plot inertia; the cost of awakening (erasure) gives emotional weight
devices.risk: 觉醒设定要克制，全员觉醒会消解主角独特性；觉醒者逻辑要自洽
devices.riskEn: Use awakening sparingly — everyone awakened dilutes the lead; an awakened character must stay self-consistent

devices.name: 快穿任务流
devices.principle: 快穿靠“一个个小世界+系统任务+结算”提供单元节奏与持续升级感，每个世界是一个独立爽点闭环
devices.principleEn: Quick-transmigration uses small worlds + system tasks + settlement for episodic rhythm and escalation; each world is a self-contained payoff loop
devices.technique: 每个小世界开场交代身份、任务、成功/失败代价与时限，3-8 集内完成“接任务—受阻—翻盘—结算”闭环；结算给可见奖励（积分/技能/记忆碎片）并埋下贯穿主线的碎片，避免单元割裂
devices.techniqueEn: Open each world with identity, task, win/fail cost and deadline; close a receive-block-turn-settle loop in 3–8 episodes; settlement grants visible rewards and a main-line fragment so episodes do not feel disconnected
devices.risk: 世界之间不能只是换皮重复；每个世界要有独立的情感命题或手法
devices.riskEn: Worlds must not be reskinned repeats; each needs its own emotional question or device

devices.name: 脱离/回归条件
devices.principle: 明确“怎样才能离开书/回到现实”给主角和观众一个总目标钩子，贯穿全剧
devices.principleEn: A clear “how to leave the book / return to reality” gives lead and audience an overarching goal-hook across the series
devices.technique: 早期立清脱离规则（完成任务/改写悲剧/集齐某物/被谁真心爱上），中途安排一次“看似能走却选择留下”的抉择强化情感，结局的离开或留下必须回扣最初规则
devices.techniqueEn: Establish exit rules early (finish the mission, rewrite the tragedy, collect items, earn true love); mid-story place a “could leave but chooses to stay” choice; the ending must callback the original rule
devices.risk: 脱离规则不能中途随意更改；临时加条件会让观众觉得被耍
devices.riskEn: Exit rules cannot change mid-story; last-minute conditions feel like cheating

devices.name: 现代知识金手指边界
devices.principle: 穿书者的现代知识/商业/审美是金手指，但必须设边界与代价，否则爽感失真、对手降智
devices.principleEn: Modern knowledge (business, taste, technology) is the cheat, but it needs limits and cost or the payoff feels fake and rivals turn dumb
devices.technique: 列出主角能用的现代知识清单并设约束（古代缺材料/产业链、世界规则禁用某类技术、知识只懂大概），每次用现代知识解题都配套一个新麻烦；让本土角色用本地智慧补上主角短板，形成搭档而非单方面碾压
devices.techniqueEn: List usable modern knowledge and its constraints (missing materials/industry, world rules banning tech, only rough know-how); each modern solution creates a new problem; let locals complement the lead with native wisdom as partners, not one-sided domination
devices.risk: 不能输出违背历史/科学常识的“神操作”，更不能让古人为难而集体降智
devices.riskEn: No historically/scientifically impossible miracles, and no dumbed-down locals to make the lead shine

engines.name: 甜宠虐恋机制

devices.name: 心动阶梯
devices.principle: 感情只能一阶一阶升温，每一次靠近都让观众明确“关系又进了一步”，跳步则工业糖精
devices.principleEn: Feelings advance one rung at a time; each step closer must read clearly — skipping rungs feels artificial
devices.technique: 开局先定关系起点与终点，中间排一条可见的升温阶梯（注意→好奇→试探→心动→在意→确认→相守），每 2-3 集只上一级并用一个具体事件承载，越级必须有强事件催化
devices.techniqueEn: Fix the relationship start and end, then lay a visible ladder (notice → curious → testing → flutter → care → confirm → commit); climb only one rung every 2–3 episodes via one concrete event, with a strong catalyst for any leap
devices.risk: 一上来就深爱、靠 BGM 硬凑都不可信；每一级都要有行为证据
devices.riskEn: Instant deep love or music-masked bonding is unconvincing; each rung needs behavioral evidence

devices.name: 极限拉扯
devices.principle: 靠近与退缩交替制造张力，观众追的是“到底什么时候在一起”的悬而未决
devices.principleEn: Alternating approach and withdrawal creates tension; viewers chase the unresolved “when will they get together”
devices.technique: 用“进一步—外部或内心阻碍退半步”的节律推进：每次靠近后给一个合理的退缩理由（责任、误会、身份），退缩时留一个舍不得的小动作，让希望不断绝；拉扯次数有上限，临近确认减少退缩
devices.techniqueEn: Use a step-forward / half-step-back rhythm: after each approach give a sound reason to pull back (duty, misunderstanding, status), but leave one reluctant micro-action so hope survives; cap the cycles and reduce withdrawal near confirmation
devices.risk: 为拉扯而反复横跳会让角色显得渣/作；每次退缩动机必须成立
devices.riskEn: Endless back-and-forth makes a character seem toxic; every withdrawal needs a valid motive

devices.name: 误会不过夜
devices.principle: 情感剧可以有误会，但不能靠“就是不听解释”硬拖，误会长度与烈度必须受控
devices.principleEn: Romance allows misunderstanding, but not a refusal-to-listen drag; its length and intensity must be controlled
devices.technique: 误会当集或次集给一次解释机会，阻碍解释的是信息结构（没碰上、被第三方打断、有难言之隐）而非角色降智；解开时让双方各自承担一部分责任，避免一方全错
devices.techniqueEn: Offer a chance to clarify within the episode or next; block clarification through information structure (missed timing, third-party interruption, a secret), not stupidity; on resolution assign each side some responsibility
devices.risk: 超过三集的低级误会招黑；不能用“你听我解释/我不听”凑时长
devices.riskEn: A low-level misunderstanding past three episodes alienates viewers; never pad runtime with “let me explain / I won’t listen”

devices.name: 暗恋视角差
devices.principle: 让观众比剧中一方更早知道心意，全知视角制造“替他着急”的高甜与高虐
devices.principleEn: Let the audience know the feelings before one character does; omniscience creates sweet-anxious and painful anticipation
devices.technique: 用镜头/独白/细节只对观众揭示一方心意（偷看、下意识维护、记得小事），另一方误读成友情/责任；在关键节点让观众以为要戳破又收住，最后由一个积累已久的细节引爆表白
devices.techniqueEn: Reveal one side’s feelings only to the audience (glances, instinctive protection, remembering small things) while the other misreads it as friendship; near a reveal pull back, then detonate the confession through a long-accumulated detail
devices.risk: 视角差不能建立在一方迟钝到失真；细节要前后一致
devices.riskEn: The gap cannot rely on implausible denseness; details must stay consistent

devices.name: 吃醋与占有边界
devices.principle: 适度吃醋是在意的证明、是糖；越界成控制与 PUA 就是雷点，必须划线
devices.principleEn: Light jealousy proves care and is sweet; crossing into control or manipulation is a red flag — draw the line
devices.technique: 吃醋用“嘴硬+小动作”表现（阴阳怪气一句、默默清掉情敌机会），随后用主动沟通或自我克制收尾；明确区分“在乎”与“限制社交/查岗/否定价值”，后者要被剧情当作问题指出并改正
devices.techniqueEn: Show jealousy through gruff words plus small actions (a sarcastic line, quietly removing a rival’s opening), then resolve by communication or self-restraint; clearly separate caring from controlling social life, surveillance or belittling — the story must flag and correct the latter
devices.risk: 绝不能把控制欲、跟踪、精神操控包装成“深情/霸总魅力”
devices.riskEn: Never package control, stalking or manipulation as “deep love / CEO charm”

devices.name: 糖刀配比
devices.principle: 先给够糖，刀才疼；先虐够，甜才爽。甜虐需要被设计成有比例的曲线而非随机
devices.principleEn: Earn the knife with enough sweetness first, and the sweetness with enough pain; design sweet/angst as a ratio curve, not randomness
devices.technique: 排一张情感节拍表：高甜后紧跟的刀要回扣之前的糖（同一细节由暖变刺），大虐之前至少铺垫两段甜；单集内部也做“小甜—小挫—回暖”的呼吸，避免全程发刀或全程工业撒糖
devices.techniqueEn: Chart an emotional beat sheet: the knife after high sweetness callbacks an earlier sweet detail (warm turns sharp); lay at least two sweet beats before a big angst; within each episode do small-sweet / small-setback / warm-up so it is neither all pain nor all saccharine
devices.risk: 没糖铺垫的虐是无病呻吟，没冲突的糖会腻；比例失衡观众弃剧
devices.riskEn: Angst without sweet setup feels hollow; sweetness without conflict bores; imbalance causes drop-off

devices.name: 虐点三拍
devices.principle: 有效虐点=误解/压力（起因）—具体伤害（爆发）—真相/代价（收束），缺一拍都是为虐而虐
devices.principleEn: Effective angst = pressure/misunderstanding (cause) → concrete hurt (burst) → truth/cost (close); missing a beat is angst for its own sake
devices.technique: 先让观众理解双方各自的处境与难处（上帝视角），伤害场景要具体到一句话/一个动作而非泛泛争吵，收束拍给出真相或让一方付出可见代价；虐点推动人物成长或关系认知，不能原地打转
devices.techniqueEn: First let the audience understand both sides (omniscience); make the hurt concrete (one line, one action) rather than vague arguing; the closing beat reveals truth or extracts a visible cost; angst must drive growth or new understanding, not loop in place
devices.risk: 靠绝症、车祸、家仇等强塞悲剧属于廉价虐；伤害不能违背已立人设
devices.riskEn: Cheap tragedies (terminal illness, crash, family feud out of nowhere) feel manipulative; hurt must not betray established character

devices.name: 破镜重圆修复
devices.principle: 复合不是一句“我原谅你”，裂痕必须被正视、道歉要有具体行动、信任要重新挣回
devices.principleEn: Reunion is not one line of forgiveness; the crack must be faced, the apology acted out, and trust re-earned
devices.technique: 分开阶段让双方各自成长并暴露上次分手的真正问题；重逢后不立刻复合，先用 2-3 个事件证明改变（说到做到、改掉旧毛病），复合仪式回扣定情信物/承诺，完成情感闭环
devices.techniqueEn: During separation let both grow and expose the real cause of the breakup; after reunion do not reconcile instantly — prove change over 2–3 events (words matched by action, old flaws fixed), then callback the token/promise to close the loop
devices.risk: 出轨/原则性伤害不能被轻描淡写洗白；复合要让观众觉得“值得”而非“将就”
devices.riskEn: Betrayal of principle must not be whitewashed; reunion must feel earned, not settled-for

devices.name: 肢体微进度
devices.principle: 情感浓度更多靠眼神、距离、触碰的细微变化传递，比直白告白更有代入感
devices.principleEn: Emotional intensity travels through micro-changes in gaze, distance and touch more immersively than explicit declarations
devices.technique: 设计一条身体距离递进线（并肩→不经意触碰→刻意靠近→牵手→拥抱），每次升级对应关系阶梯一级；用“想碰又收回”“指尖停顿”等动作替代“我喜欢你”，关键告白前先让身体诚实
devices.techniqueEn: Design a physical-distance line (side by side → accidental touch → deliberate closeness → handhold → embrace), each upgrade matching a relationship rung; replace “I love you” with reach-and-pull-back or a paused fingertip; let the body be honest before the verbal confession
devices.risk: 亲密戏要服务情感且把握尺度，不为撩而撩、不违背人物意愿（明确同意）
devices.riskEn: Intimacy must serve emotion, stay appropriate, and never override consent

devices.name: HE情绪兑付
devices.principle: 结局的爽/甜来自把前期欠观众的承诺、遗憾、伏笔逐项兑现，兑付清单越完整越满足
devices.principleEn: Ending satisfaction comes from cashing every earlier promise, regret and foreshadow one by one; the fuller the payoff list, the greater the fulfillment
devices.technique: 前期建一张“情感欠条”：未说出口的话、错过的约定、被误解的人、立过的 flag；结局按清单逐项兑付并尽量回扣原场景/原台词，主 CP 之外给重要副线一个交代
devices.techniqueEn: Keep an emotional-IOU list: unspoken words, missed plans, misunderstood people, planted flags; cash each at the ending, ideally recreating the original scene/line, and give key side-couples closure too
devices.risk: 开放式结局要留给希望而非烂尾；不能临时空降完美结局解决一切
devices.riskEn: An open ending should leave hope, not abandonment; no last-minute perfect fix that resolves everything out of nowhere

engines.name: 下沉爽剧机制

devices.name: 马甲分层揭露
devices.principle: 主角真实身份/实力要分层藏、分层揭，每揭一层都是一次爽点，一次亮完后续乏力
devices.principleEn: Hide the protagonist’s true identity/power in layers and reveal one layer at a time; each reveal is a payoff — showing all at once kills later tension
devices.technique: 开局列出主角的“身份洋葱”（表面废物→某领域高手→更高马甲→最终身份），每隔 2-4 集只揭一层，揭露前先让旁人误判、羞辱，揭露时用一个具体事件坐实；留一层到结局前引爆
devices.techniqueEn: List an identity onion upfront (seemingly useless → expert in one field → bigger alias → final identity); reveal one layer every 2–4 episodes, preceded by others misjudging or humiliating, proven by a concrete event; keep one layer for near the finale
devices.risk: 马甲必须前后一致、能自圆其说，不能临时编新身份救场
devices.riskEn: Aliases must stay consistent and self-consistent; never invent a new identity on the spot to save the scene

devices.name: 打脸阶梯递进
devices.principle: 打脸要逐级升级：对象越来越强、场面越来越公开、方式越来越解气，重复同一种打脸会腻
devices.principleEn: Face-slaps must escalate: stronger targets, more public stages, more satisfying methods; repeating the same kind numbs the viewer
devices.technique: 排一条打脸阶梯（身边小人→主管→权贵→幕后大 Boss），每次打脸换不同武器（证据/实力/人脉/身份），并让上一级被打脸者成为下一级的见证者或铺垫；单次打脸遵循“被质疑—亮证据—反转—对方失态”四拍
devices.techniqueEn: Build a ladder (petty rival → supervisor → powerful figure → hidden boss), varying the weapon each time (evidence, skill, connections, identity), making the previous loser witness the next; each slap follows four beats: doubted → evidence shown → reversal → opponent loses composure
devices.risk: 打脸靠真本事/证据，不靠主角光环强词夺理；四拍缺一不爽
devices.riskEn: Win through real ability or evidence, not protagonist halo; a missing beat weakens the payoff

devices.name: 压抑释放节奏
devices.principle: 爽感来自落差：先把主角压到谷底，释放才解气；压得越实、反弹越爽，但压抑不能超过观众耐心
devices.principleEn: Satisfaction comes from contrast: press the protagonist to the bottom first, then release; the firmer the suppression, the sweeter the rebound, but never past the audience’s patience
devices.technique: 每个爽点单元做“受压（被误解/羞辱/剥夺）—忍耐（守住底线的小动作）—蓄力（拿到证据或实力）—爆发（一次性反打）”；单次压抑控制在 1-2 集内见到第一次释放，全剧压放交替、避免连压三集以上
devices.techniqueEn: Each payoff unit runs: oppressed (misjudged/humiliated/stripped) → endure (small integrity-preserving move) → charge (gain evidence or power) → burst (counter in one move); keep a single suppression to 1–2 episodes before first release, alternating press/release, never three straight episodes of suppression
devices.risk: 为虐而虐、压太久观众弃剧；压抑期主角也要有主动性，不能纯挨打
devices.riskEn: Grim-for-its-own-sake or overlong suppression causes drop-off; even while pressed the protagonist must act, not merely suffer

devices.name: 弱者尊严锚点
devices.principle: 主角可以落魄，但必须在受辱时守住一条底线/善意，观众才会坚定站队、盼他翻身
devices.principleEn: The protagonist may be down-and-out, but must hold one line of integrity or kindness under humiliation so viewers firmly root for the comeback
devices.technique: 开局 1-2 场内立一个“尊严锚点”（再难也不偷不抢、护着家人/弱者、有一技之尊），后续每次被羞辱都让他用这个锚点回应一次；翻身之后回扣锚点，证明他没忘本
devices.techniqueEn: Set a dignity anchor in the first 1–2 scenes (won’t steal even when desperate, protects family/the weak, pride in a craft); under each humiliation let him answer through that anchor, and callback to it after rising to show he hasn’t changed
devices.risk: 不能为了卖惨让主角毫无骨气；观众同情弱者但追随有脊梁的人
devices.riskEn: Don’t strip the protagonist of all backbone for pity; viewers pity the weak but follow those with spine

devices.name: 实力金手指自洽
devices.principle: 主角强必须有可信来源（多年苦练/奇遇规则/资源积累），且能力边界与规则前后一致，不无脑开挂
devices.principleEn: Strength needs a credible source (years of training, rule-bound opportunity, accumulated resources), with consistent limits and rules — no mindless god-mode
devices.technique: 前期埋实力来源（闪回/道具/师承/系统规则），明确金手指能做什么、不能做什么、代价是什么；每次用实力解决问题都在既定规则内，遇到更强对手时靠成长或智取而非突然变强
devices.techniqueEn: Plant the power source early (flashback, item, mentor, system rules), state what the cheat can/cannot do and its cost; every win stays within those rules, and against a stronger foe rely on growth or wit rather than a sudden power-up
devices.risk: 规则随剧情需要随意变、危机靠临时新能力化解，是最大悬浮感来源
devices.riskEn: Rules shifting for plot convenience or crises solved by sudden new powers are the top source of unreality

devices.name: 反派逐级加码不降智
devices.principle: 反派越聪明、手段越狠，主角赢了才越爽；让反派降智送人头等于自降爽感
devices.principleEn: The smarter and more ruthless the antagonist, the sweeter the win; dumbing villains down to hand over victory cheapens the payoff
devices.technique: 给反派合理动机、资源与连续策略，每次失败后升级手段（从使绊子→动用关系→铤而走险）；主角靠识破算计、提前布局反制取胜，关键局让反派自以为得计后再翻盘
devices.techniqueEn: Give antagonists sound motives, resources and a sequence of tactics, escalating after each failure (obstruction → pulling strings → desperate move); the hero wins by seeing through schemes and pre-positioning, in key scenes letting the villain believe they’ve won before the reversal
devices.risk: 反派不能脸谱化到只会叫嚣；也不能让反派强到主角无法合理取胜
devices.riskEn: Avoid one-note villains who only shout; yet don’t make them so strong the win is implausible

devices.name: 围观见证放大
devices.principle: 爽点需要见证者：围观者态度从轻视到震惊到追捧的集体反转，会成倍放大打脸快感
devices.principleEn: Payoffs need witnesses: the crowd’s collective swing from disdain to shock to admiration multiplies the satisfaction
devices.technique: 关键打脸安排在公开场合（同学会、宴会、会议、家族议事），设计 2-3 个有名字/立场的旁观者做“情绪解说”，打脸前让他们唱衰、打脸时给震惊反应、打脸后态度 180 度转变；避免每次都是同一批工具人
devices.techniqueEn: Stage key slaps in public (reunion, banquet, meeting, family council), use 2–3 named bystanders as emotional commentators: dismissive before, shocked during, reversed after; avoid reusing the same faceless crowd every time
devices.risk: 围观反应要具体、有层次，不能千篇一律“倒吸一口凉气”
devices.riskEn: Crowd reactions must be specific and layered, not the same collective gasp every time

devices.name: 羞辱者仰望兑现
devices.principle: 前期踩主角最狠的人，后期要亲眼见证并为当初的羞辱付出态度代价，形成情感闭环
devices.principleEn: Whoever stepped on the hero hardest must later witness the rise and pay an attitude price, closing the emotional loop
devices.technique: 建一张“羞辱账本”：谁、在什么场合、说了什么；主角翻身时按账本逐个回扣，让羞辱者在同一类场合亲口改观/道歉/求助；最重要的羞辱者放到中后段集中兑现
devices.techniqueEn: Keep a humiliation ledger (who, where, what said); as the hero rises, callback each entry, making humiliators reverse/apologize/ask for help in a matching setting; save the biggest humiliator for a concentrated mid-late payoff
devices.risk: 兑现要符合人物逻辑，不能为解气让所有人瞬间变脸、毫无代价
devices.riskEn: Payoffs must fit character logic; not everyone flips instantly with zero cost just to satisfy

devices.name: 反击边界
devices.principle: 反击打脸要在法律与公序良俗内完成，主角可以狠但不能滥伤无辜、不能美化违法
devices.principleEn: Counterattacks stay within law and public morality; the hero may be tough but must not harm the innocent or glorify illegality
devices.technique: 让主角优先用合法手段反制（证据、合同、规则、舆论真相、让对方自食其果），私人惩戒止步于揭穿与切割；涉及暴力/商战情节时给出法律后果，不把违法手段当成正确答案
devices.techniqueEn: Prefer lawful countermeasures (evidence, contracts, rules, public truth, letting opponents self-destruct), with personal payback limited to exposure and cutting ties; where violence or business warfare appears, show legal consequences rather than treating illegal moves as the answer
devices.risk: 绝不能把违法报复、私刑、以暴制暴包装成“爽”；平台尺度红线前置
devices.riskEn: Never frame illegal revenge, lynching or might-makes-right as satisfying; platform content limits take priority

devices.name: 集尾强钩卡点
devices.principle: 下沉爽剧靠集尾钩子拉留存：把“打脸前一秒/身份将揭未揭/更强敌人登场”卡在集尾
devices.principleEn: Mass-market drama retains via end hooks: cut the episode one beat before the slap, at an almost-revealed identity, or as a stronger enemy appears
devices.technique: 每集结尾设计一个“临门一脚”钩子：证据即将出示、门即将打开、身份即将说破、对方刚放狠话；下一集开头先快速兑现上集钩子再推进，形成连续追更动力
devices.techniqueEn: End each episode on an about-to-happen card: evidence about to be shown, a door about to open, an identity about to be named, a rival’s threat just delivered; open the next episode by quickly cashing that hook before advancing, driving binge continuation
devices.risk: 钩子不能只靠故弄玄虚，下集必须快速兑现，否则观众有被欺骗感
devices.riskEn: Hooks can’t rely on empty teasing; the next episode must cash them fast or viewers feel cheated

engines.name: 无限流规则怪谈机制

devices.name: 规则前置与字面陷阱
devices.principle: 开场给出可执行的规则清单建立“游戏框架”，真正的杀机藏在字面歧义、留白与相互冲突里
devices.principleEn: Open with an actionable rule list to set the game frame; the real danger hides in wording ambiguity, omissions and conflicting rules
devices.technique: 每个副本开场用告示/广播/纸条给出 5-8 条规则，其中 1-2 条故意表述模糊或互相牵制（如“白天不要回应敲门声”却又有“听到妈妈声音必须开门”）；让主角逐条标注可疑点，规则文本后续可被回看、成为解谜证据
devices.techniqueEn: Open each instance with 5–8 rules via notice/broadcast/note, making 1–2 deliberately ambiguous or conflicting (e.g. “never answer the door by day” vs “always open for mother’s voice”); have the protagonist flag suspects so the text can be revisited as evidence
devices.risk: 规则要短、具体、可执行，不能写成大段说明文；陷阱要公平地写在字面里
devices.riskEn: Rules must be short, concrete and actionable, never info-dumps; traps must be fairly present in the wording

devices.name: 隐藏规则渐进发现
devices.principle: 隐藏规则不能直接告知，要靠观察、试错与前人留下的痕迹补全，让观众和主角同步推理
devices.principleEn: Hidden rules are never stated outright; they are pieced together through observation, trial-and-error and traces left by predecessors, letting viewers reason alongside the hero
devices.technique: 把隐藏规则拆成 3 个线索点（异常现象→前人记录/尸体姿态→小规模试探验证），主角每确认一条就更新“规则手册”；用一次可控的小代价试探代替无脑送死，发现节奏与紧张感交替
devices.techniqueEn: Split each hidden rule into three clue beats (anomaly → predecessor’s note/body posture → small controlled probe); the hero updates a rule handbook per confirmation; use a low-cost probe instead of reckless death, alternating discovery with tension
devices.risk: 试错要付出代价但不能靠配角轮流送死推进；发现过程观众可跟上
devices.riskEn: Trial costs something but must not progress by disposable side characters dying in turn; viewers must follow the discovery

devices.name: 破局线索公平
devices.principle: 最终破局用到的每条关键信息都必须提前埋下、可回推，杜绝主角光环式灵光一现
devices.principleEn: Every key fact used in the final solve must be planted early and be retraceable; no protagonist-halo eureka moments
devices.technique: 先设计破局答案，再倒推把答案拆成 2-3 个前置线索埋进前几场（道具细节、规则漏洞、NPC 一句话）；破局时让主角明确引用此前线索，观众有“原来如此”而非“凭空开挂”的感觉
devices.techniqueEn: Design the solution first, then reverse-engineer 2–3 planted clues into earlier scenes (a prop detail, a rule loophole, an NPC line); at the solve the hero explicitly cites them, earning an “of course” rather than a cheat
devices.risk: 线索不能藏到画面/台词之外，也不能靠最后一秒突然补设定
devices.riskEn: Clues cannot hide off-screen/off-line, and no last-second worldbuilding patch is allowed

devices.name: 代价与死亡重量
devices.principle: 违规必须有真实、不可逆或高成本的代价，死亡有分量，紧张感才立得住
devices.principleEn: Rule-breaking must carry real, irreversible or high-cost consequences, and death must have weight for tension to hold
devices.technique: 明确每个副本的代价梯度（警告→损失（道具/记忆/感官/队友关系）→淘汰/死亡），让主角在一次违规中真切失去点什么；即便有回档/复活机制也设置稀缺次数或后遗症，避免“死了也无所谓”
devices.techniqueEn: Define a cost ladder per instance (warning → loss of item/memory/sense/ally bond → elimination/death) and make the hero genuinely lose something in one violation; even with reset/revival, cap its uses or add after-effects so death never feels free
devices.risk: 代价呈现重心理恐惧而非血腥猎奇；死亡不渲染残忍画面，守平台尺度
devices.riskEn: Convey stakes through psychological dread, not gory spectacle; death avoids graphic cruelty to meet platform limits

devices.name: 副本单元闭环
devices.principle: 每个副本都是“进入—立规则—破局—结算”的完整闭环，单副本可独立爽，又为主线留钩子
devices.principleEn: Each instance is a closed loop of enter → establish rules → solve → settle, satisfying on its own while seeding the main arc
devices.technique: 单副本控制在 3-6 集：进入给目标与时限，中段规则博弈，结尾用既定规则反杀/逃出并结算奖励（积分/技能/情报），最后 30 秒抛一个主线碎片（下一副本线索、组织伏笔、身份疑点）
devices.techniqueEn: Keep an instance to 3–6 episodes: entry states goal and time limit, the middle plays rule games, the ending uses established rules to counter-kill/escape and settles rewards (points/skills/intel), then the final 30 seconds drop a mainline fragment (next-instance lead, organization clue, identity doubt)
devices.risk: 结算必须严格按本副本规则计算，不能临时发奖励；闭环不能烂尾
devices.riskEn: Settlement strictly follows the instance’s own rules, no ad-hoc rewards; a loop must not end unresolved

devices.name: 副本难度阶梯
devices.principle: 副本难度逐级抬升：从“遵守规则”到“利用规则”再到“与制定规则者博弈”，能力与危机同步成长
devices.principleEn: Difficulty climbs from following rules, to exploiting them, to outplaying the rule-maker; ability and crisis grow together
devices.technique: 排一条难度曲线：副本一规则直白、单一怪物；副本二规则互相矛盾、需要选择；副本三出现会利用规则的智能对手/假规则；主角的成长（经验、队友、道具）恰好够应对下一级，不留无敌感
devices.techniqueEn: Chart a curve: instance one has plain rules and one anomaly; instance two has conflicting rules requiring choices; instance three introduces an intelligent opponent who exploits rules or fake rules; the hero’s growth (experience, allies, items) is just enough for the next level, never invincible
devices.risk: 难度跃升要有铺垫，不能突然数值膨胀；主角不能无解强
devices.riskEn: Difficulty jumps need setup, no sudden power inflation; the hero must never be unbeatable

devices.name: 规则下的人心博弈
devices.principle: 最可怕的不是怪物而是人：在生存压力下写合作、背叛、信息差与道德选择，层次才厚
devices.principleEn: People, not monsters, are scariest: under survival pressure, write cooperation, betrayal, information asymmetry and moral choices for depth
devices.technique: 每个副本安排立场不同的队友/竞争者（各有隐藏目的），设计 1-2 个“规则允许但道德两难”的选择（救一人可能害全队）；让背叛有动机伏笔、合作有信任建立过程，反派也遵循自保逻辑而非纯粹使坏
devices.techniqueEn: Give each instance allies/rivals with distinct hidden aims and 1–2 morally hard choices the rules permit (saving one may doom the team); foreshadow betrayal, earn cooperation, and let antagonists follow self-preservation logic rather than generic evil
devices.risk: 人性博弈要服务破局，不写成狗血内耗；不渲染人性之恶到价值观灰暗
devices.riskEn: Human games serve the solve, not melodramatic infighting; don’t render human nature so bleak it distorts values

devices.name: 循环回档规则化
devices.principle: 时间循环/死亡回档本身也是一种“规则”：触发条件、保留什么、代价是什么必须讲清并严格执行
devices.principleEn: A time loop/death reset is itself a rule: its trigger, what carries over and its cost must be stated and strictly honored
devices.technique: 开局明确回档三要素（什么触发重置、哪些信息/物品/伤势继承、每次回档付出什么），用“继承的信息 vs 不继承的关系”制造戏剧点；给循环设上限或递减资源（每次回档可用时间更短），逼主角在有限次数内破局
devices.techniqueEn: State the reset triad early (trigger, what carries over—information/items/wounds, and the cost); mine “retained knowledge vs reset relationships” for drama; cap loops or shrink resources (less time each reset) to force a finite solve
devices.risk: 回档不能成为万能后悔药；规则一旦定下不能为方便而改
devices.riskEn: A reset is not an unlimited undo; once set, its rules cannot change for convenience

devices.name: 规则世界自洽
devices.principle: 副本世界的规则对所有人（包括怪物/Boss/设计者）一视同仁，主角靠理解规则赢，而非规则偏袒
devices.principleEn: Instance rules bind everyone equally—anomaly, boss, designer included; the hero wins by understanding rules, not by rules favoring them
devices.technique: 建一张“规则适用表”自查：每条规则约束谁、有无例外、例外的理由；Boss 的恐怖来自它更熟悉/更会利用规则而非它可以无视规则，结局让主角用 Boss 自己必须遵守的规则反制
devices.techniqueEn: Keep a rule-applicability table: whom each rule binds, exceptions and their reasons; the boss is scary because it knows/exploits rules better, not because it ignores them, and the ending counters it with a rule it too must obey
devices.risk: 严禁“剧情需要时规则失效”；世界观前后矛盾是该类型最大硬伤
devices.riskEn: Never let rules fail “because the plot needs it”; world inconsistency is the genre’s fatal flaw

devices.name: 出口与主线牵引
devices.principle: 每个副本要有明确出口目标给即时动力，同时用贯穿主线（谁造的世界、如何彻底离开）给长期追更理由
devices.principleEn: Each instance needs a clear exit goal for immediate drive, while an overarching mainline (who built this world, how to leave for good) supplies long-term binge pull
devices.technique: 单集/单副本反复可视化“出口进度”（剩余人数、钥匙碎片、距离出口层数）；主线按“疑问—线索—更大疑问”节奏每 2-3 个副本推进一格，关键 NPC/组织反复出现并与副本产出的情报咬合
devices.techniqueEn: Visualize exit progress repeatedly (people left, key fragments, floors to exit); advance the mainline every 2–3 instances as question → clue → bigger question, with recurring NPCs/organizations interlocking with instance intel
devices.risk: 主线碎片要能最终回收，不能挖一堆不填的坑；单元与主线比例均衡
devices.riskEn: Mainline fragments must eventually pay off—no pile of abandoned holes; balance unit stories and mainline

engines.name: 宅斗宫斗权谋复仇机制

devices.name: 势力棋盘
devices.principle: 开局立清各方势力、立场与核心利益，斗争才有棋盘感，观众看得懂谁在跟谁博弈
devices.principleEn: Establish each faction’s stance and core interest up front so the conflict reads as a chessboard the viewer can follow
devices.technique: 用一场家宴/请安/朝会一次性交代 3-5 股势力（嫡系/旁支、宠妃/皇后、清流/权臣）及其想要什么、怕什么、握有什么筹码；画一张隐性关系网，后续每次冲突都能在网上定位，新人物登场先补其立场
devices.techniqueEn: Use one banquet/greeting/court scene to lay out 3–5 factions (lineage branches, favored consort vs empress, scholar-officials vs strong minister) with wants, fears and leverage; keep an implicit relationship web, locate every conflict on it, and state a new character’s stance on entry
devices.risk: 势力信息要融进事件，不能大段旁白讲家谱；立场要随利益变化而流动
devices.riskEn: Faction info must ride on events, not narration dumps; stances shift with interest

devices.name: 信息差设局
devices.principle: 宅斗宫斗的核心武器是信息：谁知道什么、谁误信什么，利用信息差做局比正面冲突高级
devices.principleEn: Information is the core weapon: who knows what, who believes a falsehood; engineering asymmetry is sharper than open clash
devices.technique: 每场博弈先列“信息表”：主角知道、对手知道、观众知道各是什么；让主角故意放出半真半假的消息引对手动作，或隐瞒关键身份/证据，在对手自以为得计时揭示；观众比对手多知道一层，产生“等着看你翻车”的期待
devices.techniqueEn: Before each contest list who knows what (hero, rival, audience); have the hero leak a half-true bait or hide key identity/evidence, revealing it when the rival thinks they’ve won; let the audience know one layer more than the rival for comeuppance anticipation
devices.risk: 信息差要对观众公平（提前埋），不能靠对手突然变蠢制造
devices.riskEn: Asymmetry must be fair (planted early), not created by a suddenly stupid rival

devices.name: 证据链反杀
devices.principle: 翻盘靠可拼合的证据链与人证物证，而非临场嘴炮；证据要提前埋、逐步凑、一次收网
devices.principleEn: Turnarounds rely on a pieced-together evidence chain and witnesses, not improvised speeches; plant early, gather step by step, close the net once
devices.technique: 主角每受一次害就暗中固定一个证据（账册、药方、书信、人证、时间线破绽），把零散证据攒成闭环；收网卡点在公开场合（祠堂/家宴/大殿）当面对质，按“指控—抵赖—逐条亮证—对方崩盘”四拍推进
devices.techniqueEn: Each time the hero is wronged, secretly secure one piece (ledger, prescription, letter, witness, timeline flaw) into a closed chain; spring it in a public forum (ancestral hall/banquet/throne room) in four beats: accusation → denial → evidence shown one by one → rival collapses
devices.risk: 证据来源要合法可信、不能伪造构陷无辜；否则主角与反派无异
devices.riskEn: Evidence must be legitimate and credible, never fabricated to frame the innocent, or the hero becomes the villain

devices.name: 利益动机链
devices.principle: 每个反派与盟友的行为都由利益或恐惧驱动，动机成立，斗争才真实、不降智
devices.principleEn: Every rival and ally acts from interest or fear; sound motives make conflict real and keep characters smart
devices.technique: 给每个对手写一句“他为什么非这么做不可”（继承权、位份、家族存亡、把柄被握），其每次出手都服务这个动机；反派失败后会按利益理性调整策略（拉拢、栽赃、断臂求生）而非情绪化重复同一招
devices.techniqueEn: Give each antagonist one line on why they must act (inheritance, rank, family survival, blackmail leverage), with every move serving it; after losing they rationally adapt (co-opt, frame, cut losses) rather than repeat one tactic out of spite
devices.risk: 不能为推动剧情让反派突然智商下线或无缘无故使坏
devices.riskEn: Never dumb a rival down or make them evil for no reason just to advance plot

devices.name: 蛰伏蓄力
devices.principle: 主角开局弱势时先藏锋、攒筹码（证据/人脉/银钱/名分），时机不到不出手，出手必中
devices.principleEn: When weak at the start, the hero hides edge and accumulates leverage (evidence, allies, funds, standing), never striking before the time is ripe, then striking true
devices.technique: 排一条蓄力线：受辱—隐忍并记录—暗中结交关键人—拿到第一个把柄—小胜立威—最终清算；隐忍期用一两个“只有观众懂的反击小动作”体现主角没认命，避免憋屈感堆积
devices.techniqueEn: Chart accumulation: wronged → endure while recording → quietly recruit key people → gain first leverage → small win to establish standing → final reckoning; during endurance, insert one or two small counter-moves only the audience reads, so it never feels helplessly grim
devices.risk: 隐忍不等于窝囊受气，要让观众看到主动性与计划感
devices.riskEn: Forbearance is not passivity; the audience must see agency and a plan

devices.name: 绵里藏针对白
devices.principle: 礼制约束下古人不撕破脸当街吵，交锋靠话里有话、绵里藏针、以退为进，台词有层次才高级
devices.principleEn: Under ritual decorum people do not brawl openly; clashes run on veiled meaning, a needle hidden in silk and strategic retreat — layered dialogue feels refined
devices.technique: 冲突对白走“表面客气—话里带刺—对方听懂却抓不到错—主角笑着占上风”的路数，用称谓、敬语、典故、双关做武器；情绪最激烈时反而压低声音、用最平静的话放最狠的警告
devices.techniqueEn: Play conflict as polite surface → barbed subtext → the rival understands but cannot fault it → the hero wins with a smile; use forms of address, honorifics, allusion and double meaning as weapons; at peak emotion, lower the voice and deliver the coldest warning calmly
devices.risk: 古风台词要符合身份与时代，不能出现现代网络语；晦涩到观众听不懂也不行
devices.riskEn: Period dialogue must fit status and era (no modern slang), yet stay understandable

devices.name: 女性同盟群像
devices.principle: 跳出“女人只为男人斗”的雌竞套路，写主仆情、姐妹盟、跨阶层互助，女性配角各有立场与弧光
devices.principleEn: Move beyond women fighting only over a man; write mistress-servant bonds, sister alliances and cross-class mutual aid, with female supporting characters who have their own stances and arcs
devices.technique: 给主角配 1-2 个有独立诉求的女性盟友（忠心但有自己难处的丫鬟、同样被压迫的妯娌/嫔妃、掌握技艺的女先生/女医），关键翻盘靠同盟协作而非单一男主拯救；反派阵营也写一个“身不由己”的复杂女性，避免全员工具人
devices.techniqueEn: Give the hero 1–2 female allies with their own goals (a loyal servant with her own hardship, an equally oppressed sister-in-law/consort, a skilled female tutor/physician); key wins come through alliance teamwork, not a male lead’s rescue; give the rival side one complex trapped woman too
devices.risk: 不能把所有女性写成情敌/坏人；同盟也要有利益与信任建立过程
devices.riskEn: Don’t make every woman a rival or villain; alliances need earned trust

devices.name: 复仇账本清算
devices.principle: 把仇怨与亏欠列成账本，按轻重缓急逐个清算，节奏清晰、冤有头债有主，爽点不断档
devices.principleEn: Keep a ledger of wrongs and debts and settle them by priority; clear pacing, the right culprit for each wrong, steady payoffs
devices.technique: 开局列“谁害了谁、怎么害的、证据何在”的复仇清单，先清算外围爪牙立威、再断对手臂膀、最后直指主谋；每清算一笔回扣当初受害场景形成对照，同时让主角在复仇中守住底线、不迁怒无辜
devices.techniqueEn: Open with a list of who wronged whom, how and where the proof is; settle outer lackeys first, then cut the rival’s arms, finally the mastermind; each reckoning callbacks the original harm, while the hero keeps boundaries and never harms the innocent
devices.risk: 复仇止步于让对方承担应有代价（律法/名声/失去所依），不滥施私刑
devices.riskEn: Revenge ends in due consequences (law, reputation, loss of support), never lynching

devices.name: 身份礼制规则
devices.nameEn: Status & ritual rules as game rules
devices.principle: 嫡庶、位份、宗法、礼制就是这个世界的“游戏规则”，高手在规则内借力、用规则反制
devices.principleEn: Legitimacy, rank, patriarchal clan law and ritual are this world’s game rules; experts leverage and counter within them
devices.technique: 先讲清本局关键规则（嫡庶继承权、后宫位份与请安规矩、宗法过继/和离条件、诰命封赏），让主角用规则本身反制（以礼制压人、拿规矩堵嘴、借宗法正名）；对手若破坏规则要付出“失了名分/人心”的代价
devices.techniqueEn: Clarify the rules in play (legitimacy and inheritance, harem rank and greeting protocol, clan adoption/divorce conditions, noble titles), then let the hero counter through the rules themselves (ritual authority, rule-based rebuttal, clan-law legitimation); rivals who break rules pay in standing and support
devices.risk: 规则一旦设定全剧一致；涉及封建制度要呈现其压迫性而非理所当然地歌颂
devices.riskEn: Rules stay consistent; portray feudal institutions as oppressive rather than glorifying them

devices.name: 胜负有代价
devices.principle: 赢一局也要付出代价或结下新仇、暴露新底牌，没有零成本碾压，博弈才有张力与后劲
devices.principleEn: Every win costs something—new enmity, a revealed card, a trade-off; no zero-cost sweeps, so the contest keeps tension and momentum
devices.technique: 每次胜利后给一个“代价尾拍”：虽赢了名声却失去某个盟友、暴露了一项底牌引来更强对手、为顾全大局做了取舍；把代价转化为下一局的难题，形成“赢—付代价—再破局”的螺旋上升
devices.techniqueEn: After each win add a cost tail: reputation gained but an ally lost, a card exposed drawing a stronger foe, a trade-off for the greater good; turn that cost into the next contest’s problem, forming a win → cost → re-solve spiral
devices.risk: 代价要真实影响后续，不能嘴上说有代价实则毫发无损
devices.riskEn: Costs must truly affect later plot, not be claimed while the hero stays unscathed

engines.name: 家庭伦理年代情感机制

devices.name: 积怨账本
devices.principle: 家庭矛盾从来不是一次爆发，而是一件件具体小事层层积压，爆发时观众能逐条回溯，才真实不突兀
devices.principleEn: Family conflict never erupts from one event; concrete small wrongs pile up, so the outburst can be traced item by item and feels earned
devices.technique: 开局建一本“积怨账”：每个家庭成员被亏欠/被误解/被牺牲的具体事件各列 2-3 件并标注时间；每次冲突只翻其中一两件，总爆发时多条旧账一起收口；避免凭空冒出此前毫无铺垫的怨恨
devices.techniqueEn: Open a grievance ledger: list 2–3 concrete events per family member of being wronged/misunderstood/sacrificed with timing; each clash reopens one or two, and the final outburst closes several threads at once; never invent resentment with no prior setup
devices.risk: 旧账要靠剧情自然带出，不能用大段独白讲家史
devices.riskEn: Old grievances surface through action, not exposition monologues

devices.name: 代际立场双面
devices.principle: 彩礼、养老、生育、职业选择等代际冲突，双方都要写出可理解的立场与恐惧，不把任何一代写成纯反派
devices.principleEn: In bride-price, eldercare, childbearing or career clashes, both generations need understandable stances and fears; neither side is a pure villain
devices.technique: 每场代际冲突先写“老一辈为什么这么想”（贫穷记忆/面子/怕子女走弯路）和“年轻一代为什么抗拒”（边界/自我实现），让观众在双方之间摇摆；用具体行为而非标签化台词呈现分歧，最终不简单判一方对错
devices.techniqueEn: Before each clash write why the elders think so (memory of poverty, face, fear the child will suffer) and why the young resist (boundaries, self-fulfillment), letting viewers waver between them; show disagreement through behavior not labels, and avoid declaring one side simply right or wrong
devices.risk: 和稀泥不等于无立场，涉及违法与原则问题（家暴/侵占）不能各打五十大板
devices.riskEn: Balance is not neutrality on illegality or principle (abuse/embezzlement), which must not be treated as equally valid

devices.name: 烟火日常承载
devices.principle: 家庭情感藏在柴米油盐里：做饭、递水、收拾、攒钱等生活动作承载关系与态度，比直白说爱更有力
devices.principleEn: Family emotion lives in groceries and chores — cooking, handing water, tidying, saving money — actions that carry relationship and attitude more powerfully than declaring love
devices.technique: 每场情感戏配一个“正在做的家务/生活动作”：和解从一碗面开始、偏心从多夹一筷子菜体现、疏远从各吃各的体现；用具体物价、工资、家用补贴等数字增强年代与生活质感
devices.techniqueEn: Give each emotional scene an ongoing household action: reconciliation starts with a bowl of noodles, favoritism shows in an extra chopstick of food, distance in eating separately; use concrete prices, wages and household allowances for era and life texture
devices.risk: 细节服务情感与人物，不堆砌菜谱和流水账
devices.riskEn: Details serve emotion and character, not recipe-like padding

devices.name: 血缘与边界
devices.principle: 家庭戏的核心张力是“血缘捆绑”与“个体边界”的拉扯：爱、控制、牺牲、亏欠缠在一起，值得被认真呈现而非简单歌颂或割裂
devices.principleEn: The core tension is blood-tie bonding versus individual boundaries — love, control, sacrifice and debt intertwined, portrayed honestly rather than simply glorified or severed
devices.technique: 给主角设一条边界线（不做扶弟魔/不被安排人生/要离婚），让家人用“为你好/一家人”反复施压，呈现主角从内疚到坚定的过程；亲情最终以“尊重边界后的重新靠近”收口，而非以主角彻底顺从或断绝关系收口
devices.techniqueEn: Give the hero a boundary line (won’t endlessly fund a brother, won’t accept an arranged life, wants divorce), let family press with “it’s for your own good / we’re family,” and show the move from guilt to firmness; close on reconnection after boundaries are respected, not on total submission or estrangement
devices.risk: 不美化以爱为名的控制与索取，也不鼓吹六亲不认
devices.riskEn: Neither glorify control disguised as love nor advocate cutting off all kin

devices.name: 误解与翻案
devices.principle: 家庭剧的强泪点来自“被最亲的人误解”再到真相大白，翻案要靠证据与时间，不靠外人突然说破
devices.principleEn: A strong tear-jerker is being misunderstood by those closest then vindicated; vindication comes through evidence and time, not a stranger blurting it out
devices.technique: 先让主角被家人误解（偏心/偷钱/忘恩负义）并承担后果，埋一个只有观众知道的真相（汇款单/病历/默默付出），在关键节点由当事人自己发现、逐条对照旧账完成翻案；翻案后给误解者一个“带着羞愧的补偿动作”
devices.techniqueEn: First let the hero be misunderstood (favoritism, theft, ingratitude) and bear consequences; plant a truth only the audience knows (remittance slip, medical record, quiet sacrifice); at the key moment the family member discovers it and cross-checks the ledger for vindication, followed by an ashamed, reparative action
devices.risk: 误解期不能太长太憋屈，中段要给观众“主角没被压垮”的小动作
devices.riskEn: Don’t prolong misunderstanding into pure misery; mid-section needs small acts showing the hero isn’t broken

devices.name: 中国式家庭舞台
devices.principle: 饭桌、客厅、医院病房、老家堂屋是家庭冲突的天然舞台，多人在场时的“站队、打圆场、拉偏架”让群像活起来
devices.principleEn: The dinner table, living room, hospital ward and old-home hall are natural stages; with many present, taking sides, peacemaking and biased mediation make the ensemble come alive
devices.technique: 重要冲突安排在多人在场的家庭场合，给每个在场者一个符合其立场的反应（和事佬/拱火的/装没听见的/暗中帮主角的），用座次、添饭、离席等调度表现亲疏；避免两个人从头吵到尾的封闭对话
devices.techniqueEn: Stage key clashes at multi-person family occasions; give everyone present a stance-consistent reaction (peacemaker, provocateur, one who pretends not to hear, secret ally), and use seating, serving food and leaving the table to show closeness and distance; avoid closed two-person shouting matches
devices.risk: 群像反应要点到为止，避免支线喧宾夺主
devices.riskEn: Keep ensemble beats concise so side plots don’t hijack the scene

devices.name: 和解有代价
devices.principle: 真实的家庭和解不是一句“对不起”，而是让步、补偿、遗憾与接受“有些伤口回不去”，过程比结局动人
devices.principleEn: Real reconciliation is not a single “sorry” but concession, compensation, regret and accepting that some scars remain; the process matters more than the ending
devices.technique: 和解分三步：先有一方低头的具体行动（认错/还债/让出利益），再有一次把话说开的长谈（各自承认自己的难处与过错），最后保留一处无法完全弥补的遗憾作为余味；拒绝“所有矛盾一集清零”的悬浮大团圆
devices.techniqueEn: Reconcile in three steps: a concrete first move (admission, repaying, yielding an interest), a real talk where each side admits hardship and fault, and one irreparable regret left as aftertaste; reject floating happy endings where every conflict clears in one episode
devices.risk: 涉及家暴/重大伤害时，和解需谨慎，不能用亲情绑架受害者原谅
devices.riskEn: For abuse or grave harm, handle reconciliation carefully — never pressure a victim to forgive through family guilt

devices.name: 年代印记推动命运
devices.principle: 年代剧的个人命运要被时代节点真实推动（知青下乡、恢复高考、下岗、下海、拆迁、买房），道具与事件必须考据准确、不穿越
devices.principleEn: In era dramas, personal fate is genuinely moved by historical turning points (sent-down youth, restored college entrance exams, layoffs, going into business, demolition, home buying); props and events must be era-accurate, never anachronistic
devices.technique: 先做一张“年代时间轴”：把人物年龄、家庭大事与真实历史节点对齐；每个命运转折都由一个时代事件触发（顶替上岗、单位分房、国企改制），道具（粮票/BB机/万元户/筒子楼）服务剧情而非猎奇；用词、物价、观念严格符合年代
devices.techniqueEn: Build an era timeline aligning character ages and family events with real historical nodes; each fate turn is triggered by an era event (assigned job, work-unit housing, SOE reform), with props (grain coupons, pagers, “ten-thousand-yuan household”, shared corridor housing) serving plot, word choices, prices and values strictly period-accurate
devices.risk: 历史节点只做背景推动，不歪曲重大历史、不出现年代硬伤
devices.riskEn: Historical nodes only drive background; never distort major history or leave anachronisms

devices.name: 隐忍到总爆发链
devices.principle: 家庭主角的情绪遵循“日常隐忍—小事试探—再被踩线—总爆发”的递进链，爆发才有分量，且爆发后关系被永久改变
devices.principleEn: The hero’s emotion follows endure → small probe → line crossed again → total outburst; staged escalation gives the outburst weight and permanently changes the relationship afterward
devices.technique: 排一条四级情绪链并分布到多集：第一级忍（沉默做事）、第二级试探（委婉表达被无视）、第三级警告（明确说不仍被逼迫）、第四级总爆发（掀桌/摊牌/离开）；每级给不同的生理与语言反应，总爆发后写清谁的态度因此改变
devices.techniqueEn: Lay a four-level chain across episodes: endure (silent work), probe (polite words ignored), warn (clear refusal still pressured), outburst (showdown/leaving); give each level distinct physical and verbal reactions, and after the outburst make clear whose attitude changed
devices.risk: 隐忍期要有主角的主动性与小反击，避免窝囊感堆积
devices.riskEn: During endurance keep agency and small counter-moves to avoid helpless grimness

devices.name: 去狗血底线
devices.principle: 靠真实的利益、性格、观念差异制造冲突，而不是靠绝症车祸抱错孩子等狗血巧合；能沟通的误会不靠“就是不听”硬拖
devices.principleEn: Conflict arises from real interests, temperament and value differences, not terminal illness, car crashes or switched-at-birth coincidences; resolvable misunderstandings aren’t dragged out by characters refusing to listen
devices.technique: 每设计一个冲突先问“现实中这样的家庭会不会这样发展”，剔除无动机使坏的恶亲、连环巧合和硬误会；冲突根源落到钱、房子、赡养分工、教育理念、旧伤等现实议题；误会若本可一句话说清，就改为“说了但没人信/说了更糟”的现实障碍
devices.techniqueEn: For every conflict ask whether a real family would develop this way; strip unmotivated evil relatives, chained coincidences and forced misunderstandings; root conflict in money, housing, caregiving division, parenting philosophy or old wounds; if a misunderstanding could be cleared in one line, replace it with the realistic barrier of “said it, but nobody believed / it made things worse”
devices.risk: 可以有戏剧夸张但不能悬浮失真，更不能靠丑化疾病/残障/某群体制造冲突
devices.riskEn: Dramatic heightening is fine, floating unreality is not; never build conflict by mocking illness, disability or any group

engines.name: 职业行业剧机制

devices.name: 专业流程真实
devices.principle: 行业剧的可信度建立在标准流程上：抢救、立案、出警、庭审都有不可跳步、不可颠倒的程序，程序本身就是戏剧张力
devices.principleEn: Credibility rests on standard procedure — resuscitation, case filing, dispatch and trial have steps that cannot be skipped or reordered, and procedure itself creates tension
devices.technique: 动笔前先列出该行业一条完整标准流程（如急诊：分诊—评估—检查—诊断—处置—交接），剧情严格沿流程推进，把冲突嵌进流程节点（检查结果未出就要先决策、流程被外力打断）；关键操作步骤需可查证，宁可不写也不写错
devices.techniqueEn: Before writing, lay out one complete standard workflow (e.g. ER: triage—assessment—tests—diagnosis—treatment—handover), drive the plot strictly along it, and embed conflict at nodes (decide before results return, procedure interrupted by outside force); key steps must be verifiable — omit rather than invent
devices.risk: 流程要为剧情服务、点到为止，避免写成操作手册式科普
devices.riskEn: Procedure serves drama and stays concise, never a textbook manual

devices.name: 行话落地不堆砌
devices.principle: 专业术语要准确，但必须借人物动作或通俗解释让观众秒懂；术语密度服务真实感，堆砌名词只会出戏
devices.principleEn: Jargon must be accurate yet instantly understandable through action or plain paraphrase; density serves realism, name-dropping breaks immersion
devices.technique: 每出现一个专业术语，紧跟一个可视化动作或一句“翻译成人话”的对白（用比喻、对家属解释）；同一集术语不堆砌，优先用观众能感知的症状/证据/后果替代冷僻名词；术语与岗位级别匹配，实习生说不出主任级判断
devices.techniqueEn: Follow each term with a visible action or plain-language line (a metaphor, an explanation to family); don’t cluster jargon in one episode, prefer symptoms/evidence/consequences the audience can feel; match jargon to seniority — an intern wouldn’t voice an attending’s call
devices.risk: 解释要自然融入对白，不能变成对着镜头讲课
devices.riskEn: Explanation must live naturally in dialogue, never lecturing the camera

devices.name: 职业伦理两难
devices.principle: 行业剧最高级的冲突是“两个都对”的伦理两难：程序正义与结果正义、救一个还是救一群、保密与告知，没有标准答案才耐嚼
devices.principleEn: The finest conflict is a dilemma where both sides are right — procedural vs substantive justice, save one vs save many, confidentiality vs disclosure; no easy answer is what lasts
devices.technique: 给主角设置一道两难选择题并明确两边代价（违规救人但要担责 / 守程序但眼睁睁失去机会），让不同岗位角色持不同立场争论；主角的选择要承担真实后果，不能两头好处都占；避免用反派使坏替代真正的伦理困境
devices.techniqueEn: Force a dilemma with clear costs on both sides (break protocol to save someone but face liability, or follow it and lose the chance), let roles of different positions argue each side; the hero’s choice carries real consequences, never gets both rewards; don’t replace a genuine dilemma with a villain’s scheming
devices.risk: 两难不能和稀泥，价值观底线（生命权、程序正义）不能被功利计算压倒
devices.riskEn: Don’t fudge the dilemma; baseline values (right to life, procedural justice) must not be overridden by mere expediency

devices.name: 师徒传承线
devices.principle: 老带新是行业剧天然的成长结构：书本知识与现场经验的碰撞、师徒互相改变，让专业能力的传承可感
devices.principleEn: Mentoring is a natural growth structure: textbook knowledge collides with field experience, mentor and protégé change each other, and the passing-on of craft becomes tangible
devices.technique: 设一对师徒/新老搭档：新人按书本与理想行事、老人凭经验与教训判断，前期冲突、中期老人的旧伤被新人治愈、后期新人独立做出让老人认可的判断；用一次具体的“手把手教学”场面展示真本事，而非口头夸能力
devices.techniqueEn: Pair a rookie (by the book, idealistic) with a veteran (experience, past lessons): clash early, the rookie heals the veteran’s old wound mid-way, and finally makes a call the veteran respects; show craft in one concrete hands-on teaching scene rather than praising competence in words
devices.risk: 师傅不能是全知工具人，也要有自己的局限与成长
devices.riskEn: The mentor isn’t an omniscient tool — they have limits and growth too

devices.name: 高压时间窗
devices.principle: 行业剧的紧张感来自真实的时间窗：黄金抢救时间、举证期限、火势蔓延、审讯时限，倒计时把专业决策逼到极限
devices.principleEn: Tension comes from real time windows — golden rescue time, evidence deadlines, fire spread, interrogation limits — a countdown that forces expert decisions to the edge
devices.technique: 为关键事件设定一个有行业依据的倒计时并让观众明确感知（还剩多少时间、每拖延一分钟代价是什么）；在时间窗内安排两难判断、资源不足、信息不全三重压力；时间流逝用具体动作（监护仪数字、烟层下降、证据时效）呈现，而非空喊“快一点”
devices.techniqueEn: Set an evidence-based countdown for the key event the audience can read (time left, the cost of each minute lost), and layer three pressures inside it: a dilemma, scarce resources, incomplete information; show elapsed time through concrete signs (monitor numbers, descending smoke layer, expiring evidence), not shouts of “hurry”
devices.risk: 倒计时长度要符合行业常识，不能为了紧张违背物理与医学规律
devices.riskEn: Countdown length must fit industry reality; never violate physics or medicine for suspense

devices.name: 专业失误与复盘
devices.principle: 专业主角也会判断失误，真实的失误、代价与复盘让人物可信、让专业被尊重；永不犯错的“神”反而悬浮
devices.principleEn: Professionals misjudge too; real mistakes, their cost and the post-mortem make characters credible and honor the craft — an infallible genius feels fake
devices.technique: 安排一次主角基于当时信息做出的“合理但错误”的判断，写出真实后果（病情恶化/败诉/险情升级），随后用一场复盘（病例讨论/案后分析/战评）找出偏差、明确责任、改进流程；主角要直面责任而不是甩锅，失误成为后续成长的伏笔
devices.techniqueEn: Give the hero a reasonable-but-wrong call given the information at hand, show the real consequence (worsening condition, lost case, escalated danger), then a review (case discussion, post-incident analysis, debrief) that locates the error, assigns responsibility and improves process; the hero faces responsibility instead of shifting blame, and the mistake seeds later growth
devices.risk: 失误不能源于低级愚蠢或违规，复盘不能流于形式口号
devices.riskEn: The mistake must not be stupidity or rule-breaking, and the review must not be empty slogans

devices.name: 多岗位协作链
devices.principle: 真实行业靠团队：一台手术、一场救援、一次公诉需要多岗位精密配合，协作链让专业世界立体、避免主角独角戏
devices.principleEn: Real professions run on teams — surgery, rescue and prosecution need precise multi-role coordination; the chain makes the professional world three-dimensional and avoids a one-man show
devices.technique: 为关键战役安排 3-4 个不同岗位角色各司其职（主刀/麻醉/护士、指挥/破拆/供水、侦查/技侦/法医），用简短指令与交接体现配合节奏；让某个辅助岗位在关键时刻起决定性作用；主角的成功明确依赖团队，而非一个人包打天下
devices.techniqueEn: Staff the key battle with 3–4 roles each owning a job (surgeon/anesthetist/nurse; commander/forcible-entry/water-supply; detective/tech-forensics/medical examiner), show rhythm through terse orders and handovers; let a supporting role turn the tide at a key moment; the hero’s success visibly depends on the team
devices.risk: 辅助岗位要有姓名与立场，不能是只会“收到”的背景音
devices.riskEn: Supporting roles need names and stances, not background voices that only say “copy”

devices.name: 病例/案情层层反转
devices.principle: 行业剧的智力快感来自逼近真相：初步诊断/结论被新证据推翻、再推翻，每次反转都基于专业逻辑而非巧合
devices.principleEn: The intellectual pleasure is closing in on truth: the initial diagnosis/conclusion is overturned by new evidence, again and again, each reversal grounded in professional logic, not coincidence
devices.technique: 设计三层认知：表面结论（看似显然）→专业疑点（一个对不上的细节）→真相（用专业知识重新拼合）；每次推翻都由一个新检查结果/证据/证词触发，并让主角的专业敏感度成为发现疑点的关键；反转后回看，所有线索早已埋下
devices.techniqueEn: Build three layers: surface conclusion (seems obvious) → professional anomaly (one detail that doesn’t fit) → truth (reassembled with expertise); each overturn is triggered by a new test result/evidence/testimony, with the hero’s professional sensitivity spotting the anomaly; in hindsight every clue was planted
devices.risk: 反转不能靠隐瞒关键信息骗观众，医学/法律推理要经得起推敲
devices.riskEn: Never hide key information to fool the audience; medical/legal reasoning must hold up

devices.name: 职业侵入私人生活
devices.principle: 职业身份会侵入私人关系与情绪：医生见多生死后的麻木、律师的辩论习惯带回家、救援者的创伤，让人物不只是岗位符号
devices.principleEn: Professional identity invades relationships and emotion — a doctor’s numbness after witnessing death, a lawyer bringing argument habits home, a rescuer’s trauma — so characters are more than job titles
devices.technique: 给主角安排一条与职业强相关的私人困境（因值班失约家庭、因职业习惯与亲人争执、因一次失败留下PTSD），让工作中的选择在私人线产生回响；私人线反过来影响一次职业决策，形成闭环；用生活细节而非自述表现职业烙印
devices.techniqueEn: Give the hero a private struggle tightly tied to the job (missing family due to shifts, arguing with kin out of professional habit, PTSD after a failure), and let work choices echo in the private line, which in turn shapes a professional decision to close the loop; show the professional imprint through life details, not self-narration
devices.risk: 感情线要服务人物与主题，不能变成与职业无关的悬浮偶像剧
devices.riskEn: Romance serves character and theme, never floating idol-drama unrelated to the job

devices.name: 专业即爽点
devices.principle: 行业剧的爽点不是开挂，而是千万次训练形成的硬本事在关键时刻一击制胜：精准判断、神级操作、当庭翻盘
devices.principleEn: The payoff isn’t a cheat power but hard-won mastery from endless training landing at the critical moment — a precise call, a masterful move, a courtroom turnaround
devices.technique: 前期埋“枯燥基本功”（反复练习、记背、模拟、被师傅挑剔），关键时刻用一次干净利落的专业操作解决别人解决不了的难题，并让外行角色的反应衬托其含金量；爽点必须有前期训练做支撑，且符合科学与法律规律，不能违背常识开挂
devices.techniqueEn: Plant tedious fundamentals early (drills, memorization, simulations, the mentor’s criticism), then at the key moment solve what others couldn’t with one clean expert move, framed by a layperson’s reaction to show its value; the payoff must be earned by prior training and consistent with science and law — never an implausible power-up
devices.risk: 专业爽感不能神化到违背行业规律，更不能靠违规操作制造英雄
devices.riskEn: Never mythologize expertise beyond industry reality or manufacture heroism through rule-breaking

engines.name: 男频玄幻修仙升级机制

devices.name: 境界阶梯清晰
devices.principle: 升级流的地基是一套读者随时能对照的境界体系：每一级有明确的能力边界、标志与寿命/地位变化，越级才有分量
devices.principleEn: The foundation is a ladder readers can check at any time: each realm has clear ability bounds, hallmarks and changes in standing, so crossing realms means something
devices.technique: 开篇先定死境界序列（小境界×大境界）与每级“能做什么/不能做什么”，主角当前境界、下一境界门槛、关键配角境界在大纲阶段就列成对照表；每次突破明确写出跨越了哪条能力边界，不临时新增未铺垫的境界
devices.techniqueEn: Fix the realm sequence (minor and major stages) and what each can/cannot do up front; list the hero’s realm, the next threshold and key characters’ realms in the outline; every breakthrough states which ability boundary was crossed, never inventing unseeded realms on the spot
devices.risk: 境界数量要克制，过多过碎读者记不住、后期必通胀
devices.riskEn: Keep the number of realms restrained; too many tiny stages confuse readers and inflate the late game

devices.name: 突破有代价
devices.principle: 升级绝不能白给：资源、悟性、机缘、心魔、失败风险至少占其一，跨过门槛的艰难让收获有重量
devices.principleEn: Leveling is never free: resources, comprehension, fortune, inner demons or failure risk must apply, so hard-won gains carry weight
devices.technique: 每次突破前先交代缺什么（缺丹药/缺感悟/被人追杀时限），突破过程设置一个真实障碍（走火入魔、天劫、资源被抢、心境关），并让主角付出可感知的代价（寿元、旧伤、人情、暴露底牌）；失败或险胜比一路平推更有记忆点
devices.techniqueEn: Before each breakthrough state what is missing (pill, insight, a deadline under pursuit), set a real obstacle (qi deviation, heavenly tribulation, stolen resources, a state-of-mind trial), and exact a felt price (lifespan, an old wound, a favor owed, exposing a trump card); a narrow or failed attempt is more memorable than a smooth climb
devices.risk: 代价不能只写在设定里，要落到后续剧情（旧伤会复发、人情要还）
devices.riskEn: The price must echo later (old wounds recur, favors are called in), not stay on the spec sheet

devices.name: 金手指有规则
devices.principle: 系统、外挂、特殊体质是男频引擎，但必须有明确规则、限制与代价（冷却、反噬、条件触发），万能金手指会杀死所有张力
devices.principleEn: A system, cheat or special constitution drives the genre, but it needs clear rules, limits and costs (cooldown, backlash, trigger conditions); an omnipotent cheat kills all tension
devices.technique: 为主角金手指写一张“规则卡”：能做什么、不能做什么、触发条件、使用代价、成长方式；每次靠金手指取胜都受规则约束并留下后患或暴露风险；金手指随主角变强而成长，但永远保留一条它解决不了的难题，逼主角用智慧与心性破局
devices.techniqueEn: Write a rule card for the cheat: what it can/cannot do, triggers, costs and growth path; every win through it obeys the rules and leaves fallout or exposure risk; it grows with the hero but always faces one problem it cannot solve, forcing wit and character
devices.risk: 不能“需要时突然冒出新功能”，新能力必须提前埋线
devices.riskEn: Never sprout a new function when convenient — new abilities must be seeded in advance

devices.name: 战力标尺一致
devices.principle: 战力是男频的硬通货：谁强谁弱必须有稳定标尺，以弱胜强要靠明确依据（底牌、地形、克制、算计），绝不吃书
devices.principleEn: Power scaling is the genre’s hard currency: relative strength needs a stable ruler, and winning against odds needs explicit grounds (a hidden card, terrain, counter, scheme), never retconning
devices.technique: 维护一张“战力账本”：记录每个角色境界、招式、底牌与已展现的战绩，对决前让读者能据此预判；以弱胜强时让主角的赢来自提前布局/属性克制/信息差/临场悟道，并解释为什么强者会输；不允许同一招式时强时弱
devices.techniqueEn: Maintain a power ledger of each character’s realm, techniques, trump cards and shown record so readers can predict fights; an underdog win comes from prior setup, attribute counter, information gap or on-the-spot insight, with the strong side’s loss explained; a move must not be strong one moment and weak the next
devices.risk: 为爽感临时拔高主角、削弱反派是战力崩坏的主因，须禁止
devices.riskEn: Never arbitrarily buff the hero or nerf the villain for a cheap thrill — that is the main cause of power-scaling collapse

devices.name: 机缘多方争夺
devices.principle: 天材地宝、秘境、传承不是主角白捡：多方势力围绕机缘博弈，机缘伴随风险、抉择与代价，拿到才爽
