devices.technique: 写感情线时同步推进她的个人目标，让“选不选这段关系”与“我要成为谁”对齐；避免用结婚/被求婚作为大团圆唯一标志，可为不同女性安排不同形态的幸福（事业、友情、亲情、自洽），尊重多元选择
devices.techniqueEn: Advance her personal goal alongside romance so choosing the relationship aligns with who she wants to become; avoid marriage or a proposal as the sole happy ending, and give different women different forms of fulfillment—career, friendship, family, self-peace
devices.risk: 不为“独立”而强行否定一切感情，避免另一种政治正确的刻板
devices.riskEn: Don’t reject all romance to signal independence—that is its own stereotype

devices.name: 身体与年龄友好
devices.principle: 不把容貌、身材、年龄、婚育状态当成女性的价签或焦虑开关：中年可以有魅力与欲望，普通长相可以有光芒，审美多元本身就是力量
devices.principleEn: Looks, body, age and marital status are not price tags or anxiety switches: middle age has desire and charm, ordinary looks radiate, and diverse beauty is itself strength
devices.technique: 用具体魅力替代外貌评判（能力、幽默、气场、温柔的力量），让年龄成为经验与资源而非倒计时；若呈现容貌焦虑，要让人物最终与自己和解而非靠“变美打脸”；不出现体重羞辱、年龄羞辱的“爽”
devices.techniqueEn: Replace appearance judgments with concrete appeal (competence, humor, presence, gentle strength) and make age experience and resource rather than a countdown; if body anxiety appears, resolve through self-reconciliation rather than a glow-up revenge, and never play body- or age-shaming for triumph
devices.risk: 也不反向制造“美貌原罪”，对各类外形一视同仁
devices.riskEn: Nor treat beauty as guilt; treat all appearances even-handedly

devices.name: 困境真实但保有力量
devices.principle: 女性题材可以写苦难（家暴、出轨、职场打压、生育之痛），但不消费苦难、不渲染猎奇：落点永远是人物的主体性——她如何认知、反抗、求助、重建
devices.principleEn: Women’s stories may face hardship—domestic abuse, betrayal, workplace suppression, the pain of childbirth—but never consume or sensationalize it; the landing is always agency: how she recognizes, resists, seeks help and rebuilds
devices.technique: 写伤痛前先想“这一集她主动做了什么”，让每个受难点都伴随一次主体性动作（取证、求助、离开、反击、设立边界）；涉及家暴/性侵等只呈现必要程度、不拍猎奇细节，并给出真实合法的求助路径与支持系统，结局的疗愈来自她重新掌握生活
devices.techniqueEn: Before a hardship beat ask what she actively does, pairing each with an agentic move (gathering evidence, seeking lawful help, leaving, pushing back, setting boundaries); show abuse or assault only as needed, never sensationally, provide real lawful help routes and support, and let healing come from regaining control of her life
devices.risk: 涉及违法侵害只导向合法解决，不提供以暴制暴的错误示范，不二次伤害式呈现
devices.riskEn: Unlawful harm is resolved only lawfully—no vigilante modeling, no re-traumatizing depiction

engines.name: 国运秘境全民觉醒机制

devices.name: 秘境规则即引擎
devices.principle: 国运流的核心悬念来自“规则”：副本怎么通关、违规受什么罚、边界在哪，开场立清且全程不反悔，智斗才有舞台，观众才能跟着解题
devices.principleEn: The suspense of a national-fortune story comes from rules: how to clear the realm, penalties, boundaries—set early, never bent later, so clever play and audience participation become possible
devices.technique: 进副本前用一张“规则卡”交代3-5条铁律（通关条件、计时、违规代价、一条看似无用的细节），关键转折必须是主角对既有规则的再解读，而不是临场新增设定；规则漏洞只能用一次，用后由系统补漏，避免反复钻空子失真
devices.techniqueEn: Before entry, state 3-5 iron rules on a rule card (clear condition, timer, violation cost, one seemingly useless detail); every turning point must re-interpret an existing rule rather than add a new one on the spot; any loophole works once and is then patched, preventing repeat abuse
devices.risk: 规则解释要融进紧张动作，禁止大段说明书式念稿
devices.riskEn: Fold rule explanation into tense action; never deliver a long manual

devices.name: 国运联动账可见
devices.principle: 爽感来自“我赢一分，国家强一分”的即时联动：个人表现与国运资源、国民状态挂钩，数值可见、前后对得上，观众才有命运与共感
devices.principleEn: The thrill is “I gain, the nation gains”: personal results link visibly to national resources and citizens’ state, with consistent numbers that create shared stakes
devices.technique: 定一套统一计量（国运点/资源值），写清“通关S级=多少点=现实兑换什么（粮产、医疗、寿命、领土屏障）”，每次结算当场播报增减，前后集数值连续；主角受创时国家同步承压，把个人战斗升级为集体命运
devices.techniqueEn: Define one currency (fortune points), fix what an S-clear yields and what it buys (food, medicine, lifespan, a barrier), report gains/losses on screen each time and keep numbers consistent across episodes; when the hero is hurt the nation feels it, lifting a personal fight into collective fate
devices.risk: 数值换算一张表管到底，杜绝这集一分顶百、下集百分顶一
devices.riskEn: One conversion table for the whole story; never inflate or deflate points episode to episode

devices.name: 代表资格有来路
devices.principle: 主角代表国家不能靠“偏偏选了他”的天降：选拔或征召过程要成立，他凭什么站上赛场要被看见，代表资格本身就有代价与责任
devices.principleEn: A national representative cannot be anointed out of nowhere: the selection must be credible, his qualification visible, and representation itself carry cost and duty
devices.technique: 用1-2场戏交代选拔逻辑（基层海选、特殊职业适配、上一次失败的替补、能力被低估的冷门），让质疑者真实存在并在首战后改观；给他一个“本可以不去”的选择点，主动担责才立住人物，拒绝纯龙傲天
devices.techniqueEn: Use 1-2 scenes to establish selection (grassroots trial, profession fit, substitute after a prior failure, an underrated ability), let doubters exist and revise after the first battle; give him a real chance to opt out—choosing duty is what makes him a character, not a mary-sue
devices.risk: 选拔不能黑箱内定，程序公平本身就是爽点前提
devices.riskEn: Selection must look fair; procedural fairness underpins the payoff

devices.name: 资源经济算得清
devices.nameEn: A resource economy that adds up
devices.principle: 积分、装备、天材地宝的获取与消耗构成微型经济：有稀缺、有取舍、有积累，主角的每个选择都付了成本，变强才不廉价
devices.principleEn: Points, gear and rare materials form a mini-economy with scarcity, trade-offs and accumulation; every power-up costs something so strength is never cheap
devices.technique: 列一张主角资源台账（初始、每战净增、关键消耗、兑换目标），安排至少一次“资源用在救人还是强化自己”的两难；稀有掉落必须伴随高风险，禁止敌人无限送装备
devices.techniqueEn: Keep a resource ledger (starting amount, net gain per fight, key spends, upgrade goal), and stage at least one dilemma—spend to save others or to self-enhance; rare drops require high risk, foes never farm out infinite gear
devices.risk: 账要经得起观众算，消耗与获取逐集对得上
devices.riskEn: The ledger must survive viewer scrutiny across episodes

devices.name: 多国博弈不脸谱
devices.principle: 赛场是多国棋盘：对手国选手各有文化逻辑与战术风格，强者值得尊重，博弈靠策略而非对方集体降智，赢才含金
devices.principleEn: The arena is a multi-nation board: foreign rivals carry coherent cultural logic and tactical styles, the strong deserve respect, and victory comes from strategy rather than collective enemy stupidity
devices.technique: 给2-3个主要对手国（建议用虚构国名/泛称，如“北境联盟”）各立一套打法与一名可敬选手，安排一次主角靠学习对手思路破局；反派可以傲慢，但要有傲慢的资本与逻辑，禁止现实国旗对骂式丑化
devices.techniqueEn: Give 2-3 main rivals (preferably fictional names such as “the Northern League”) distinct styles and one honorable player each, and once let the hero win by learning from a rival’s idea; antagonists may be arrogant but need grounds for it—never real-flag insult or caricature
devices.risk: 对手国一律虚构化/泛称化，不映射现实国家民族、不煽动仇恨
devices.riskEn: Fictionalize/generalize rival nations; never map to real countries or incite hatred

devices.name: 国民围观放大器
devices.principle: 全民直播围观是国运流的情绪放大器：从质疑到屏息到沸腾，舆论的弧线就是观众情绪的镜像，但弹幕要有层次、不能只会喊666
devices.principleEn: The livestreamed national audience amplifies emotion: doubt to hush to euphoria mirrors the viewer, but reactions need layers, not uniform cheering
devices.technique: 设计三类声音（质疑派/专业派/路人转粉）随战局递进转变，关键操作前压一条不看好的评论、操作后让同一ID“打脸式”改口；用现实侧一个普通家庭/哨所的反应把宏大国运落到具体的人
devices.techniqueEn: Design three voices (doubters, experts, converts) that shift with the fight; before a key play show a dismissive comment, after it let the same handle reverse in embarrassment; ground grand national stakes in one ordinary family or outpost reacting on the home front
devices.risk: 弹幕克制使用，避免刷屏淹没剧情；不搞民粹式辱骂
devices.riskEn: Use barrage sparingly so it never drowns the plot; no populist abuse

devices.name: 能力体系自洽有顶
devices.nameEn: A self-consistent power system with a ceiling
devices.principle: 觉醒职业、等级、技能克制构成可推演的体系：强弱有边界、克制有逻辑、升级有代价，主角的强是“用对了体系”而非作者随时加码
devices.principleEn: Awakened classes, levels and counters form a deducible system with bounds, logical matchups and costly growth; the hero wins by using the system well, not by authorial power inflation
devices.technique: 开篇立“职业树+等级上限+克制环”（如力/敏/智/辅互相牵制），主角的隐藏能力也要遵守体系规则、只在应用方式上出奇；每次升级写明代价（寿元、副作用、冷却），关键战前让观众知道他还差什么
devices.techniqueEn: Establish a class tree, level cap and counter-loop (might/agility/intellect/support); even hidden powers obey system rules and surprise only in application; every upgrade states a cost (lifespan, side effect, cooldown), and before key fights show what he still lacks
devices.risk: 禁止“危急时刻突然觉醒新技能”无铺垫破体系
devices.riskEn: No unseeded sudden awakening that breaks the system in a crisis

devices.name: 解谜优先于蛮力
devices.principle: 副本最精彩的赢法是读懂规则、借势打力：用环境、机制、怪物特性解题，智斗让普通观众有“原来如此”的参与快感
devices.principleEn: The best realm win reads the rules and leverages environment, mechanics and monster traits; clever problem-solving gives viewers an “aha!” participation high
devices.technique: 每个副本埋一个“机制题眼”（怪物只认移动热源、地形会反弹、规则文字有双关），提前给线索、让主角先试错一次再破解；硬碰硬只作为解题后的收尾，不作为主解法
devices.techniqueEn: Bury one mechanical key per realm (the monster tracks moving heat, terrain rebounds, rule wording is a pun), seed clues, let the hero fail once then solve; raw force only finishes what cleverness set up, never carries the main solution
devices.risk: 题眼线索必须前置可回看，不能靠主角凭空猜到
devices.riskEn: Clues must be seeded and rewatchable, never guessed from nothing

devices.name: 代价阶梯式加压
devices.principle: 压迫感来自代价逐级升级：个人负伤→队友折损→国民承压→国家危亡，每跨一级观众的揪心程度上一个台阶，最终胜利才有重量
devices.principleEn: Tension comes from escalating cost: personal injury, teammate loss, public burden, national peril—each rung raises dread so the final win has weight
devices.technique: 把全剧代价分四级排进时间线，前几集只付小代价并明示“再失败会怎样”，中段真的让一名配角付出不可逆代价（不复活、不洗白），终局把主角逼到“赢了比赛也可能失去某人”的两难
devices.techniqueEn: Map four cost levels onto the timeline: early episodes pay small costs while stating the next penalty, the midpoint truly charges a supporting character an irreversible price (no revival, no whitewash), and the finale forces “win yet possibly lose someone”
devices.risk: 代价要真兑现，不能每次都“刚好没事”消解紧张
devices.riskEn: Costs must actually be paid; repeated last-second rescues drain tension

devices.name: 文化根脉巧制胜
devices.principle: 主角的深层优势是文化根脉：用历史智慧、传统技艺、东方哲学解题，文化自信落在“真有用”的情节里，而非角色喊口号
devices.principleEn: The hero’s deep advantage is cultural roots: historical wisdom, traditional craft and Eastern philosophy solve problems, cultural confidence shown through genuine utility rather than slogans
devices.technique: 选1-2个具体文化点（榫卯结构、孙子兵法虚实、节气物候、中医辨证、围棋弃子）提前铺垫其原理，让它成为破解某副本的关键钥匙；用行动结果说话，让外国对手由衷认可而非被说教
devices.techniqueEn: Pick 1-2 concrete cultural elements (mortise-tenon structure, Sunzi’s void-and-substance, solar-term phenology, TCM pattern differentiation, Go sacrifice), seed how they work, then make one the key to a realm; let results speak and a rival admire genuinely rather than being lectured
devices.risk: 文化点要查证准确、服务解题，杜绝堆砌名词与贬低他国
devices.riskEn: Verify cultural details and make them serve the puzzle; no name-dropping or belittling others

hooks.name: 直接冲突型
hooks.technique: 不交代背景，直接进争执/打脸/对峙，背景靠后续补
hooks.example: 婚礼现场，新娘把戒指甩在新郎脸上

hooks.name: 强悬念型
hooks.technique: 枪口、化验单、神秘来电，先给结果再回溯
hooks.example: 一份DNA鉴定摊在桌上，她手在抖

hooks.name: 极致反差型
hooks.definition: 上一秒巅峰下一秒谷底
hooks.technique: 用身份/境遇的剧烈落差制造好奇缺口
hooks.example: 前一秒她是总裁夫人，下一秒被保安拖出大楼

hooks.name: 身份逆转钩
hooks.definition: 表面身份与真实身份错位
hooks.technique: 一句身份压制句点破隐藏底牌
hooks.example: 所有人都以为我是保姆，不知道这栋楼是我家的

hooks.name: 绝境钩
hooks.technique: 建立时限与严重后果(stakes)，观众必须看解法
hooks.example: 倒计时十分钟，绑匪让她选一个孩子

hooks.name: 倒计时钩
hooks.technique: 显性时钟制造压迫感
hooks.example: 距离手术签字失效还有20分钟

hooks.name: 惊天揭露钩
hooks.technique: 用信息炸弹重写人物关系
hooks.example: “你护了二十年的恩人，就是当年害你家的人。”

hooks.name: 反常画面钩
hooks.technique: 视觉反常先抓住眼，再解释
hooks.example: 普通街道上，他背后突然展开一对翅膀

hooks.name: 金句开场钩
hooks.technique: 高信息密度金句即钩子
hooks.example: “我嫁的不是人，是这座城最深的局。”

hooks.name: 隐忍卖惨钩
hooks.definition: 被剥夺时不哭不闹，面无表情咽下，心里记下复仇倒计时
hooks.technique: 惨得有尊严、反弹延后；当众剥夺要够真，给隐忍一个明确兑付期限，比当场开挂高级
hooks.example: 他咽下所有羞辱，只在心里说：还有二十七天，你们就该跪了

hooks.name: 认知颠覆钩
hooks.definition: 第一句推翻常识：你以为的X其实是Y
hooks.technique: 摘取全剧最诡异/最颠覆的一个判断放第一段，只给结论不解释为何，撬动认知基石
hooks.example: 物理学，不存在了。

hooks.name: 危机断点
hooks.definition: 集尾停在危险降临瞬间
hooks.technique: 动作未完成处切断，下一集首承接
hooks.example: 门被撞开的刹那，画面黑掉

hooks.name: 揭秘断点
hooks.technique: 关键信息说到一半切断
hooks.example: “其实你的亲生母亲是——”本集完

hooks.name: 反转断点
hooks.technique: 最后10秒给预期违背
hooks.example: 一直帮她的人，转身拨通了反派的电话

hooks.name: 抉择断点
hooks.technique: 把道德/利益两难抛给观众
hooks.example: 救母亲还是救女儿，她抬起了手

hooks.name: 情感断点
hooks.technique: 付费解锁点：情绪峰值即卡点
hooks.example: 他单膝跪下的瞬间，集终

hooks.name: 新变量断点
hooks.technique: 引入改变格局的新变量后切断
hooks.example: 会议室门开，来的竟是“死去”的他

hooks.name: 目标受阻钩
hooks.definition: 角色目标刚建立就被打断
hooks.technique: 场末让新障碍出现，驱动下一场
hooks.example: 她刚拿到合同，对方宣布作废

hooks.name: 信息抛出钩
hooks.definition: 场末丢出一条关键信息
hooks.technique: 用一句新情报勾住下一场
hooks.example: “监控里那天，还有第二个人。”

hooks.name: 转场疑问钩
hooks.technique: 问题不在本场回答，切到平行线索
hooks.example: 她盯着空存折，镜头切到奢侈品店的丈夫

hooks.name: 动作钩子
hooks.definition: 一个反常/危险/意味深长的动作
hooks.technique: 用动作代替解释，展示而非讲述
hooks.example: 他笑着，却把遗嘱往火里推了推

hooks.name: 语言钩子
hooks.definition: 话里有话/一语双关/没说完
hooks.technique: 潜台词制造张力，避免说教式直说
hooks.example: “你跟你爸，真是一模一样。”（她脸色骤变）

hooks.name: 氛围钩子
hooks.definition: 环境/光影/声音突变制造不安
hooks.technique: 用氛围预示，不直接说破
hooks.example: 楼道声控灯一层层熄灭，脚步声没停

hooks.name: 情绪钩子
hooks.definition: 情绪反差/隐忍将爆/共情细节
hooks.technique: 给一个具体的情绪载体动作
hooks.example: 她笑着说没事，手却把纸巾攥成了团

hooks.name: 信息差钩子
hooks.definition: 观众知角色不知(戏剧反讽)或反之
hooks.technique: 利用认知差制造紧张/期待
hooks.example: 观众看见身后有人，她还在开心做饭

hooks.name: 伏笔钩子
hooks.technique: 随手埋、后面必须兑现(payoff)
hooks.example: 第一集特写的旧钥匙，第十八集打开保险柜

hooks.name: 感官钩子
hooks.technique: 用具体感官落地烟火气与临场感
hooks.example: 雨水混着铁锈味灌进喉咙

hooks.name: 微反转钩子
hooks.technique: 一句/一个动作级别反转保持鲜活
hooks.example: 她递出辞职信，老板却先递来升职书

hooks.name: 连环钩
hooks.definition: 第一句抓住人后第二句立刻再锁一次，禁止转去铺垫
hooks.technique: 感官钉死(视觉转听觉)/倒刺问题(结论后跟矛盾)/视角爆破(宏观缩微观)三选一
hooks.example: 血从天花板渗下来——正落进他面前的咖啡杯，洇开一圈暗红

hookStrategies.name: 均衡标准流
hookStrategies.tagline: 张弛有度、钩子与留白均衡，最稳妥的通用选择
hookStrategies.taglineEn: Even tension and breathing room — the safe all-purpose default
hookStrategies.fit: 绝大多数题材、新用户首选、平台常规节奏
hookStrategies.fitEn: Most genres; first-time users; standard platform pacing

hookStrategies.name: 强钩密集流
hookStrategies.tagline: 开场即冲突、场场有牵引、卡点更狠，最大化完播与追更
hookStrategies.taglineEn: Open on conflict, pull every scene forward, harder cliffhangers — maximize completion and binge
hookStrategies.fit: 逆袭打脸、战神赘婿、复仇爽剧、下沉市场、追求强留存

hookStrategies.name: 悬念牵引流
hookStrategies.tagline: 问题先行、伏笔连环、集尾揭秘将揭未揭，勾着观众找答案
hookStrategies.taglineEn: Questions first, chained foreshadowing, reveal-cut endings that pull the audience toward the answer
hookStrategies.fit: 悬疑烧脑、刑侦法医、谍战、推理罪案、科幻解谜
hookStrategies.fitEn: Mystery, procedural/crime, spy, detective, sci-fi puzzle

hookStrategies.name: 情绪沉浸流
hookStrategies.tagline: 以情绪载体与潜台词推进，集尾停在情绪峰值，靠共情留人
hookStrategies.taglineEn: Advance through emotion carriers and subtext; end on emotional peaks; retain via empathy
hookStrategies.fit: 都市情感、甜宠虐恋、家庭年代、萌宝银发、女性群像、治愈
hookStrategies.fitEn: Urban romance, sweet/angst, family, kids & elders, women’s ensemble, healing

hookStrategies.name: 精品慢热流
hookStrategies.tagline: 减少硬卡点、靠氛围与质感细钩留人，留白更多、更高级
hookStrategies.taglineEn: Fewer hard cliffhangers; retain via atmosphere and textured micro-hooks with more breathing room
hookStrategies.fit: 精品短剧、电影感、文艺现实向、平台获奖/品牌定制
hookStrategies.fitEn: Premium/arthouse, cinematic, realistic drama, award/brand productions

paceStrategies.name: 标准张弛流
paceStrategies.tagline: 冲突与留白均衡，一集一个完整小起伏，最通用
paceStrategies.taglineEn: Balanced conflict and breathing room, one small arc per episode — the universal default
paceStrategies.fit: 绝大多数题材、新用户、平台常规节奏
paceStrategies.fitEn: Most genres; new users; standard pacing
paceStrategies.directive: 节奏采用标准张弛：每场有明确目标与一次小对抗，中后段一个转折，集尾卡点；动作行约占两成，避免台词墙也避免流水账。
paceStrategies.directiveEn: Use standard ebb-and-flow pacing: each scene has a clear goal and one small clash, one turn mid-late, an end hook; keep about 20% action/atmosphere beats—no dialogue walls, no flat chronicle.

paceStrategies.name: 快剪强冲流
paceStrategies.tagline: 短场景、快切换、冲突连环，最大化爽感与完播
paceStrategies.taglineEn: Short scenes, rapid cuts, chained conflict — maximize payoff and completion
paceStrategies.fit: 逆袭打脸、战神赘婿、复仇爽剧、动作、下沉市场
paceStrategies.fitEn: Comeuppance, war-god/son-in-law, revenge, action, mass market
paceStrategies.directive: 节奏快剪强冲：场景短、切换快，几乎每场都抛对抗或新信息并逐级升级，每1-2场一个小反转，集尾强卡点；少铺垫、少环境描写，冲突先行、背景后补。
paceStrategies.directiveEn: Use fast-cut high-impact pacing: short, rapidly switching scenes, a clash or new piece of info in nearly every scene escalating in steps, a mini-twist every 1-2 scenes and a hard cliffhanger; minimal setup and environment description—conflict first, background later.

paceStrategies.name: 悬念递进流
paceStrategies.tagline: 信息逐场释放、压力层层加码，勾着观众找答案
paceStrategies.taglineEn: Dole out information scene by scene, layer pressure, pull toward the answer
paceStrategies.fit: 悬疑、刑侦法医、谍战、推理罪案、科幻解谜
paceStrategies.fitEn: Mystery, procedural, spy, detective, sci-fi puzzle
paceStrategies.directive: 节奏采用悬念递进：每场推进一条线索、同时抛出一个新疑问，信息只给七分给三分；中段安排一次误导性转折，集尾停在真相将揭未揭；用光影/声音的氛围行加压，不靠吵闹靠“想知道”。
paceStrategies.directiveEn: Use suspense-escalation pacing: every scene advances one clue while opening a new question, reveal seven-tenths and withhold three-tenths; place one misleading turn mid-episode and cut at an almost-reveal; pressurize with light/sound atmosphere beats—drive by curiosity, not noise.

paceStrategies.name: 情绪波浪流
paceStrategies.tagline: 情绪有起有伏、先压后放，给共情与泪点留沉淀
paceStrategies.taglineEn: Emotions rise and fall, press then release; leave room for empathy and tears to land
paceStrategies.fit: 都市情感、甜宠虐恋、家庭年代、萌宝银发、女性群像、治愈
paceStrategies.fitEn: Urban romance, sweet/angst, family, kids & elders, women’s ensemble, healing
paceStrategies.directive: 节奏采用情绪波浪：冲突以关系和观念碰撞为主，不赶；情绪先压住再释放，一场激烈冲突后给一个生活流小动作或沉默让情绪沉淀；集尾停在情绪峰值或和解瞬间，约三成留白。
paceStrategies.directiveEn: Use emotional-wave pacing: conflicts are mainly relationship and value clashes, never rushed; press emotion then release it, and after a heated clash give a small everyday gesture or silence so the feeling lands; end on an emotional peak or reconciliation, with about 30% breathing room.

paceStrategies.name: 电影慢板流
paceStrategies.tagline: 长场景、氛围铺陈、克制卡点，靠质感与余味留人
paceStrategies.taglineEn: Longer scenes, atmospheric buildup, restrained hooks—retain through texture and aftertaste
paceStrategies.fit: 精品短剧、电影感、文艺现实、品牌定制、获奖向
paceStrategies.directive: 节奏采用电影慢板：场景偏长，冲突内化为处境与两难，靠表演与氛围而非争吵；转折偏晚且克制，不硬卡点，集尾用余味式留白；约四成笔墨给环境、光影与停顿，让它们参与叙事。
paceStrategies.directiveEn: Use cinematic slow-burn pacing: longer scenes, conflict internalized into situation and dilemma, carried by performance and atmosphere rather than arguing; turns arrive late and restrained, avoid forced cliffhangers, end on an aftertaste open beat; spend about 40% on setting, light and pauses that tell the story.

dialogueStrategies.name: 自然口语
dialogueStrategies.tagline: 像真人说话，允许断句和口头语，通用默认
dialogueStrategies.taglineEn: Real human speech with broken sentences and fillers — the universal default
dialogueStrategies.directive: 台词走自然口语：能念出口、像真人说的，允许断句、省略主语和少量口头语；禁止工整对仗、书面连接词与说教总结。
dialogueStrategies.directiveEn: Write natural spoken dialogue: speakable and human, allowing broken sentences, dropped subjects and a few fillers; forbid neat parallelism, written connectives and preachy summary lines.

dialogueStrategies.name: 市井烟火
dialogueStrategies.tagline: 高度口语、带生活糙感与地方味，接地气
dialogueStrategies.taglineEn: Highly colloquial, rough-edged everyday texture with local flavor
dialogueStrategies.fit: 现实题材、下沉、乡村乡土、市井、年代
dialogueStrategies.fitEn: Realism, mass market, rural, street-level, period everyday
dialogueStrategies.directive: 台词走市井烟火：高度口语，短碎直，带生活糙感；可少量点染查证过的地方语气词/俚语，但不堆砌、不生造方言、不拿口音取乐；避免任何文绉绉表达。
dialogueStrategies.directiveEn: Write street-level grassroots dialogue: highly colloquial, short, fragmented and direct with rough everyday texture; a few verified local particles/slang are allowed, never piled up, never invented, and accent is never a joke; remove any bookish phrasing.

dialogueStrategies.name: 锋利机锋
dialogueStrategies.tagline: 短兵相接、话里有话，一句顶一句
dialogueStrategies.taglineEn: Verbal fencing with subtext, every line landing
dialogueStrategies.fit: 商战、权谋、谍战、悬疑、职场博弈、大女主
dialogueStrategies.fitEn: Business war, court intrigue, spy, mystery, workplace duel, strong female lead
dialogueStrategies.directive: 台词走锋利机锋：人物短兵相接，话里有话、绵里藏针，用潜台词和信息差制造张力；每句都推进利益或关系，删掉一切废话，但仍要能念出口、不写书面论文。
dialogueStrategies.directiveEn: Write sharp, subtext-driven dialogue: characters fence verbally, lines carry hidden meaning and veiled pressure, tension comes from subtext and information gaps; every line advances interest or relationship with no fluff, yet stays speakable rather than essay-like.

dialogueStrategies.name: 克制规整
dialogueStrategies.tagline: 措辞讲究、相对规整，适配古装与精英场域
dialogueStrategies.taglineEn: Refined, relatively formal wording for period and elite settings
dialogueStrategies.fit: 古装权谋、历史、精英职场、精品文艺
dialogueStrategies.directive: 台词走克制规整：措辞讲究、句式相对完整，符合古装/精英场域的身份与时代；但不堆砌辞藻、不掉书袋、不出现现代网络词穿越，情绪仍要真实可感。
dialogueStrategies.directiveEn: Write restrained, polished dialogue: refined wording and relatively complete sentences fitting a period or elite setting and the speaker’s status; avoid florid padding, pedantry and anachronistic internet slang, while keeping emotion real and felt.

dialogueStrategies.name: 网感年轻
dialogueStrategies.tagline: 轻快有梗、吐槽感强，贴合年轻观众语感
dialogueStrategies.taglineEn: Light, meme-aware, roasty, tuned to young audiences
dialogueStrategies.fit: 校园、青春、都市轻喜、甜宠、二次元向
dialogueStrategies.fitEn: Campus, youth, urban light comedy, sweet romance, anime-gen adjacent
dialogueStrategies.directive: 台词走网感年轻：轻快短促、有当代年轻人的吐槽与自嘲，可少量用当下通行热梗但点到为止、不堆砌、不用已过时的梗；人物依旧逻辑自洽，不为玩梗牺牲剧情。
dialogueStrategies.directiveEn: Write internet-native youth dialogue: light, snappy, with contemporary roast and self-deprecation; a few currently common memes are fine, used lightly—never piled up or dated; characters stay consistent and plot is never sacrificed for a meme.

emotionStrategies.name: 均衡叙事
emotionStrategies.tagline: 爽点、反转、情绪起伏均衡配比，最通用
emotionStrategies.taglineEn: Balanced mix of payoff, reversal and emotion — the universal default
emotionStrategies.directive: 情绪曲线走均衡叙事：爽点、反转、情绪释放交替出现、不偏科，单集有一次小满足、集尾留追更张力，避免单一情绪疲劳。
emotionStrategies.directiveEn: Use a balanced emotional arc: alternate payoff, reversal and emotional release without over-weighting any one; give one small satisfaction per episode and end with a pull to continue, avoiding single-emotion fatigue.

emotionStrategies.name: 爽感密集
emotionStrategies.tagline: 打脸逆袭连环给爽，压缩憋屈、快速兑现
emotionStrategies.taglineEn: Chain face-slaps and comebacks; compress grievance, cash out fast
emotionStrategies.fit: 逆袭打脸、战神赘婿、复仇、男频爽剧、下沉
emotionStrategies.fitEn: Comeuppance, war-god/son-in-law, revenge, male-lead power fantasy, mass market
emotionStrategies.directive: 情绪曲线走爽感密集：憋屈铺垫尽量短、每隔一小段就兑现一次打脸/逆袭/身份碾压的爽点并逐级加码，反派被压制要给足反应镜头，让观众持续“解气”。
emotionStrategies.directiveEn: Use a dense-payoff arc: keep grievance setup short, cash out a face-slap/comeback/status-crush payoff every short stretch and escalate; give ample reaction beats when the antagonist is crushed so viewers keep feeling vindication.

emotionStrategies.name: 虐心拉扯
emotionStrategies.tagline: 误会与遗憾层层加压，释放点克制、催泪
emotionStrategies.taglineEn: Layer misunderstanding and regret, release sparingly — tear-jerking
emotionStrategies.fit: 虐恋、意难平、家庭亲情、女性向情感、悲剧
emotionStrategies.fitEn: Angst romance, unresolved regret, family, female-skewing emotion, tragedy
emotionStrategies.directive: 情绪曲线走虐心拉扯：用误会、错过、隐忍层层加压，希望与失望反复横跳，情绪释放点克制而精准，把最大的眼泪留给关键集；人物克制表达、靠细节和停顿传递心碎，不喊口号式卖惨。
emotionStrategies.directiveEn: Use an angst-and-tug arc: layer misunderstanding, missed timing and restraint, oscillate hope and disappointment, release emotion sparingly and precisely, saving the biggest tear for a key episode; characters express feeling obliquely, heartbreak carried by detail and pause rather than overt misery-selling.

emotionStrategies.name: 甜暖治愈
emotionStrategies.tagline: 高甜与温柔疗愈为主，冲突轻、暖意足
emotionStrategies.taglineEn: Mostly sweetness and warm healing; light conflict, strong warmth
emotionStrategies.fit: 甜宠、轻喜、治愈、银发萌宝、女性群像、生活流
emotionStrategies.fitEn: Sweet romance, light comedy, healing, elders/kids, women’s ensemble, slice-of-life
emotionStrategies.directive: 情绪曲线走甜暖治愈：以心动、善意、和解与小确幸为主调，冲突轻量且快速化解，每集至少一个被理解/被偏爱/被治愈的暖时刻；不制造狗血误会，靠细节糖和生活温度留人。
emotionStrategies.directiveEn: Use a sweet-healing arc: heart-flutter, kindness, reconciliation and small joys dominate; conflicts stay light and resolve quickly, with at least one moment of being understood/favored/healed per episode; avoid melodramatic misunderstanding, retain viewers through detailed sweetness and everyday warmth.

emotionStrategies.name: 反转烧脑
emotionStrategies.tagline: 信息差与认知反转驱动，结尾必掀桌
emotionStrategies.taglineEn: Driven by information gaps and cognitive reversals, end with an upheaval
emotionStrategies.fit: 悬疑、刑侦、推理、谍战、无限流、高智商博弈
emotionStrategies.fitEn: Mystery, procedural, detective, spy, time-loop, high-IQ duel
emotionStrategies.directive: 情绪曲线走反转烧脑：以信息差和认知颠覆驱动，每集埋一个可回收的误导、掀一次认知小桌，集尾停在最大疑点；反转必须有前置伏笔、回看成立，不靠角色突然黑化或天降设定。
emotionStrategies.directiveEn: Use a twist-puzzle arc: drive by information gaps and cognitive upheaval, plant one recoverable misdirection and overturn one assumption per episode, end on the biggest open question; every reversal needs prior foreshadowing and must hold on rewatch—no sudden villain turns or dropped-in facts.

characterStrategies.name: 立体真实
characterStrategies.tagline: 隐性设定托底、行为有动机，配角也有自己的日子，最通用
characterStrategies.taglineEn: Hidden backstory drives motivated behavior; even minor characters have their own lives — universal default
characterStrategies.fit: 绝大多数题材、新用户、现实题材
characterStrategies.lead: 表层目标之下还有一层底层欲望与恐惧，决定带可追溯的前史
characterStrategies.leadEn: beneath the surface goal lies a deeper want and fear, each decision traceable to backstory
characterStrategies.relation: 每个配角有独立诉求，与主角是利益/情感的真实交汇而非工具
characterStrategies.relationEn: every supporting character pursues an independent goal and crosses the lead for real reasons, never as a plot tool
characterStrategies.directive: 人物走立体真实路线：每个主要角色补齐隐性设定（原生家庭、行为习惯、喜好禁忌、思维模式、底层欲望），决策必须能从其性格与前史推出；配角同样有自己的目标与难处，不为推进主角剧情而突然变脸；用生活细节（习惯动作、旧物、口头禅）让人物落地，禁止脸谱化标签人。
characterStrategies.directiveEn: Build grounded, real characters: give every major figure a hidden profile (family of origin, habits, likes/taboos, mindset, deepest want), so each decision follows from personality and backstory; supporting characters pursue their own goals and hardships and never flip merely to advance the lead’s plot; ground people in lived detail (habitual gestures, worn objects, catchphrases); forbid flat label-people.

characterStrategies.name: 极致反差
characterStrategies.tagline: 表里/身份/预期三重反差，开局即记忆点，爽剧钩子型
characterStrategies.taglineEn: Triple contrast (surface vs inner, identity, expectation) — an instant hook for power-fantasy drama
characterStrategies.fit: 逆袭打脸、战神赘婿、扮猪吃虎、马甲流、身份流
characterStrategies.lead: 主角外在人设与真实实力/身份形成强反差，反差分层、逐级揭马甲
characterStrategies.leadEn: the lead’s outward persona sharply contrasts real power/identity; reveals are layered and escalate
characterStrategies.relation: 周围人按错误的表层认知行动，反差揭穿时群体反应是爽点弹药
characterStrategies.relationEn: others act on a mistaken surface read; their reactions when the mask drops fuel payoff
characterStrategies.directive: 人物走极致反差路线：主角外在标签（落魄/窝囊/小人物）与真实底牌（实力/身份/资源）形成强烈但自洽的反差，马甲分层、逐级揭开、每次揭开都回收前文伏笔；反派与围观者基于错误的表层认知合理地轻视主角，揭穿时给足态度反转与反应镜头；反差必须有隐情支撑，不能为装而装、逻辑硬凹。
characterStrategies.directiveEn: Use extreme contrast: the lead’s outward label (down-and-out / weak / nobody) sharply yet coherently contrasts hidden cards (power/identity/resources); identities are layered and peeled one level at a time, each reveal cashing in earlier foreshadowing; antagonists and onlookers reasonably underestimate the lead based on the false surface, and the unmasking must show full attitude reversal and reaction beats; the contrast needs a real hidden reason—never posturing with forced logic.

characterStrategies.name: 关系拉扯
characterStrategies.tagline: 关系本身就是发动机：双强博弈/欢喜冤家/相爱相杀
characterStrategies.taglineEn: The relationship is the engine: two strong leads, banter-to-bond, love-hate friction
characterStrategies.fit: 甜宠、都市情感、双男主/双女主、欢喜冤家、虐恋
characterStrategies.fitEn: Sweet romance, urban relationship, dual-lead, enemies-to-lovers, angst romance
characterStrategies.lead: 两个主角都有完整主体性，吸引与对抗同源、拉扯推动剧情
characterStrategies.leadEn: both leads keep full agency; attraction and conflict share one root, friction drives plot
characterStrategies.relation: 关系按“对立—试探—松动—绑定—危机”推进，每次进退都改变权力位
characterStrategies.relationEn: the bond moves clash→probe→soften→bind→crisis, every move shifting the power balance
characterStrategies.directive: 人物走关系拉扯路线：双主角都有独立目标与底线，谁也不是谁的附属；两人的吸引力与冲突来自同一个结构性矛盾（立场/身份/旧怨/利益），关系按对立—试探—松动—绑定—危机逐级推进，每一次靠近与推开都伴随权力位变化和可感知的情绪账；配角情感线服务主线但不复制主关系模式；禁止靠误会硬拖、靠降智制造冲突。
characterStrategies.directiveEn: Use bond-and-friction: both leads hold independent goals and bottom lines, neither subordinate to the other; their attraction and conflict spring from one structural contradiction (stance/identity/old grudge/interest), and the bond progresses clash→probe→soften→bind→crisis, every pull and push shifting the balance of power with a felt emotional ledger; side romances serve the main line without copying its pattern; forbid stalling via misunderstanding or conflict via character stupidity.

characterStrategies.name: 群像并立
characterStrategies.tagline: 多线主角各有弧光、功能不重叠，织成一张关系网
characterStrategies.taglineEn: Multiple leads with distinct arcs and non-overlapping roles woven into one relationship web
characterStrategies.fit: 家庭、职场、女性群像、市井、行业、年代群像
characterStrategies.fitEn: Family, workplace, women’s ensemble, street-level, industry saga, period ensemble
characterStrategies.lead: 每位线主角有独立欲望、缺陷与弧光，观众能分别站队
characterStrategies.leadEn: each POV character has an independent want, flaw and arc; viewers can root for each separately
characterStrategies.relation: 关系网呈网状而非主配辐射，冲突来自目标与价值观的真实碰撞
characterStrategies.relationEn: a web rather than a lead-and-satellites star; conflict arises from real clashes of goals and values
characterStrategies.directive: 人物走群像并立路线：设置3-5位线主角，每人有独立欲望、明显缺陷与完整弧光，性格功能（理性/冲动/圆滑/刚烈等）互不重叠、台词声音可盲辨；关系呈网状交织，冲突来自目标与价值观的真实对撞而非坏人使坏；每集至少给一位非主视角角色属于自己的高光时刻；切换视角时信息与情绪连续，禁止工具配角和背景板家人。
characterStrategies.directiveEn: Use an ensemble: field 3-5 POV characters, each with an independent want, a clear flaw and a full arc; their personality functions (reason/impulse/diplomacy/steel etc.) never overlap and their voices are identifiable with names hidden; relationships form a web where conflict springs from genuine clashes of goals and values rather than villainy; give at least one non-POV character their own highlight per episode; keep information and emotion continuous across POV switches; forbid tool-supporting-casts and wallpaper family members.

characterStrategies.name: 成长蜕变
characterStrategies.tagline: 缺陷—触发—试炼—蜕变，弧光本身就是主线
characterStrategies.taglineEn: Flaw→trigger→trial→transformation; the arc itself is the main line
characterStrategies.fit: 热血、青春、励志、治愈、竞技、少年向
characterStrategies.fitEn: Hot-blooded, youth, inspirational, healing, sports/competition, coming-of-age
characterStrategies.lead: 开局有明确性格缺陷或认知盲区，转变靠代价换来、不跳级
characterStrategies.leadEn: open with a clear flaw or blind spot; change is earned at a cost, never skipped
characterStrategies.relation: 导师/对手/伙伴分别承担照见缺陷、施加压力、提供支撑的功能且自身也在变
characterStrategies.relationEn: mentor/rival/friend mirror the flaw, apply pressure and give support, while changing themselves
characterStrategies.directive: 人物走成长蜕变路线：主角开局带明确缺陷或认知盲区，经触发事件入局，在连续试炼中付出真实代价、逐级转变，关键蜕变前先有至暗时刻；成长三步一回头——旧我会反复、会犹豫，转变才可信；导师、对手、伙伴分别照见缺陷、施加压力、提供支撑且各自有变化；禁止开局满级、突然顿悟、被别人说教两句就脱胎换骨。
characterStrategies.directiveEn: Use a growth arc: the lead opens with a clear flaw or blind spot, enters via a trigger, pays real costs through successive trials and changes step by step, with a darkest moment before the key transformation; growth zigzags—the old self relapses and hesitates, which makes change credible; mentor, rival and friend respectively mirror the flaw, apply pressure and provide support, each changing as well; forbid starting overpowered, sudden enlightenment, or reinvention after one lecture.

genres.name: 都市重生流
genres.realityPain: 现实试错成本极高、人生没有撤回键（买房、爱错人、报错专业一步错步步错）
genres.compensation: 人生后悔药：带着未来视野降维弥补遗憾
genres.shortDramaFit: 第一集开场即重生+第一个果断修正动作（踹渣男/锁定暴涨机会），把网文几章的铺垫压到前30秒
genres.avoid: 都重生了还拖日常、还和上一世拖累自己的人纠缠不清

genres.name: 偷听心声/读心流
genres.realityPain: 现实人情虚伪、人人戴面具，猜别人心思耗尽精力（职场PUA、亲戚假笑）
genres.compensation: 降维审判权：一眼看穿底牌的上帝视角
genres.shortDramaFit: 心声用字幕/画外音直给，反派“嘴上说 vs 心里想”同屏对撞，3秒一个打脸
genres.avoid: 写成主角和反派明面对骂（低级）；要让伪善被当众揭穿

genres.name: 种田基建流
genres.realityPain: 现实充满不确定性（裁员、烂尾、失控），灵魂流浪、缺一块绝对安全的领地
genres.compensation: 确定性反馈避风港：一分耕耘十分收获、努力必回报
genres.shortDramaFit: 适合女频治愈/逆袭副线，用“越变越好”的可视化进度给安全感，冲突以化解而非摧毁收尾
genres.avoid: 为制造高潮反复破坏主角建好的东西，违背读者来找治愈的初衷

genres.name: 无敌满级流
genres.realityPain: 被“延迟满足、先苦后甜”榨干，苦全吃了福没享到，没耐心陪主角熬成长
genres.compensation: 即时回报精神SPA：不费吹灰之力的碾压
genres.shortDramaFit: 开局即大佬、扮猪吃虎，反派跳得越高摔得越碎，绝不安排主角苦战吐血
genres.avoid: 让主角前三集受委屈、和敌人大战三百回合

genres.name: 苟道/扫地僧流
genres.realityPain: 怕做出头鸟、能者多劳被压榨、出风头就背锅
genres.compensation: 安全感+掌控感：用微不足道的身份掌控至高权力
genres.shortDramaFit: 用“只有观众知道主角多强”的信息差制造爽感，众人嘲讽时观众已在等打脸
genres.avoid: 主角为了面子当场争辩；苟是降维打击前的伪装不是真窝囊

genres.name: 断亲/决裂流
genres.realityPain: 人情社会慢性绞杀、以爱为名的道德绑架、“都是一家人”被迫吸血
genres.compensation: 绝对情感切割：替读者做现实中不敢做的冷血决裂
genres.shortDramaFit: 第一集就决裂（砸信物转身走），反派后期下跪求原谅也冷漠，迟来的深情比草贱
genres.avoid: 反派一掉泪悔过就大团圆；让主角声泪俱下控诉（不够狠）

genres.name: 斩意中人/搞事业流
genres.realityPain: 亲密关系高成本低回报（彩礼、情绪拉扯、背叛），当够了卑微舔狗
genres.compensation: 自我为王、绝不内耗：把讨好别人的精力全用来搞钱变强
genres.shortDramaFit: 开场手撕渣男/绿茶后立刻转向事业翻盘，男主/女主清醒独立，不恋爱脑
genres.avoid: 主角为感情寻死觅活、卑微求爱

genres.name: 清醒癫狂流
genres.realityPain: 现实对谁都得赔笑脸、被体面死死压住，活得憋屈
genres.compensation: 安全地失控：拥有掀翻酒席、说真话的特权
genres.shortDramaFit: “整顿职场/整顿全家”名场面，疯子说正常人不敢说的真话，行为出格但句句在理
genres.avoid: 写成纯生理失控、为疯而疯、逻辑崩盘

genres.name: 悲剧黑化流
genres.realityPain: 现实里太多无能为力、无效努力、以爱为名的绞杀
genres.compensation: 被逼到临界点后掀桌黑化的极致清算（悲剧是爽点的情绪杠杆）
genres.shortDramaFit: 前几集把现实痛点快速压到临界，主角转变要有观众“早该如此”的正当性
genres.avoid: 为虐而虐、靠死人流血制造悲剧（现代观众已麻痹）

genres.name: 系统金手指流
genres.realityPain: 普通人缺一个确定能改变命运的抓手（本条视频仅标题级，结合金手指技法）
genres.compensation: 精神抗争与确定的上升通道
genres.shortDramaFit: 系统提示音/面板可视化直给，任务-奖励即时反馈，代价制造悬念
genres.avoid: 毫无代价的新手大礼包、只会发任务的客服式系统

genres.name: 戏中戏/元叙事套层
genres.realityPain: 现实常让人分不清“被安排的角色”与“真实的自己”——职场人设、社交表演、剧本式人生，人人都在演，又都想知道戏外真相
genres.compensation: 双重解谜的智力快感与“看穿全局”的优越感：观众同时追两层故事，比剧中人更早摸到套层底牌
genres.shortDramaFit: 第一集就用一个“戏外眼神/穿帮细节”埋套层钩子，3集内让观众确认“这出戏另有目的”；内层冲突必须能反打外层关系（排练的争吵正是真实裂痕），避免两层各演各的
genres.avoid: 为套层而套层、两层故事互不咬合、规则朝令夕改导致观众看不懂；戏中戏不能替代真实情感，套层揭晓后人物动机仍要立得住
